# qmd-prover

## Introduction

qmd-prover is two things: a **fixed way of writing mathematics**, and a **tool that checks the
writing follows it** and that each proof holds up.

The way of writing is simple. All mathematics lives in `.qmd` files. Every definition, lemma,
proposition, theorem, corollary, and proof sits in its own fenced block, and every proof names the
results it uses, right where it uses them:

```markdown
::: {#def-even .definition name="Even number" date="2026-07-13"}
An integer $n$ is **even** when $n = 2k$ for some integer $k$.
:::

::: {#thm-sum-even .theorem name="Sum of two even numbers" date="2026-07-13"}
If $a$ and $b$ are even, then $a + b$ is even.
:::

::: {.proof of="thm-sum-even"}
By @def-even, write $a = 2k$ and $b = 2m$. Then $a + b = 2(k + m)$, which is even by @def-even.
:::
```

The rules that make this checkable:

- **One block per fact.** A `:::`-fenced div with exactly one kind class (`.definition`, `.lemma`,
  `.proposition`, `.theorem`, `.corollary`), a nonempty `name`, an ISO `date`, and a nonempty body.
- **The ID prefix matches the kind**: `def-`, `lem-`, `prp-`, `thm-`, `cor-`. Every explicit ID is
  unique across the whole project.
- **The proof is a separate block** with no ID of its own, linked by `of="<result-id>"` — a result
  and its proof share one identity, the result's `@id`. A statement and its proof are never mixed.
- **Every dependency is cited as `@id` at its point of use** — including the definition of any
  non-standard term at its first load-bearing use. That citation is the dependency; there is no
  separate "Uses" list.
- **Across files, cite *and* import.**
  An `@id` citation is a dependency but does not grant cross-file scope. The producer sets
  `export="<same-ID>"`, and the consumer imports that exact ID in its front matter.
- **Protected main goals.** IDs beginning `thm-main-` carry `.theorem .goal`, and their statement and
  title are locked. Never edit one.
- **Workflow state lives in div attributes, never in prose.** `.disproof` (this proof refutes the
  statement), `.draft` (deliberately unfinished, never checked), `.abandon` (kept for memory only).
  There are no body markers: `OPEN`, `VERIFIED`, `REJECTED`, and `DISPROVED` are ordinary words with
  no meaning in QMD source.

Because the writing is fixed, the work can be checked in two layers:

- **Mechanical checks (no AI).** A plain program reads the blocks and the `@id` citations and
  confirms the wiring: unique IDs, well-formed declarations, every proof linked to a real statement,
  every citation resolving to something in scope, no cycles. This says nothing about whether the
  mathematics is right.
- **The independent verifier (AI).** A separate AI reads one proof at a time and answers one
  question: assuming exactly the statements this proof cites, does the argument establish exactly
  this statement? It never sees how those cited results were proved.

Neither layer is formal verification, proof checking, or human review. The verifier is optional;
without one, everything still gets the mechanical checks and every proof stays `unverified`.

**Work like a programmer.** Inspection is the debugger. Write a coherent piece, inspect it, repair
what it flags, then build on it — rather than writing a whole development and checking at the end. A
coherent piece may be one lemma or a large batch; size it to the argument.

The complete authoring rules are the project contract in [references/AGENTS.md](references/AGENTS.md),
which is also copied into the project's own root `AGENTS.md`. Read both before writing mathematics.

## Where the documentation lives

This file is the working manual: the outline of every command, one worked example each, and the full
list of what each accepts. When that is not enough, go to the references — they cover every case.

| File | Covers |
|---|---|
| `SKILL.md` (this file) | How to work: setup, the checking loop, what each command is for. |
| [references/AGENTS.md](references/AGENTS.md) | The project contract: every declaration, proof, import, export, and conduct rule. Must match the project's own `AGENTS.md`. |
| [references/cli.md](references/cli.md) | Every command, argument, option, output field, exit code, diagnostic code, and the verifier packet protocol. |
| [references/config.md](references/config.md) | Every `.qmd-prover/config.yml` setting, every environment variable, the state-directory layout, and the external-basis file. |
| [references/status.md](references/status.md) | The complete status model: four fields, every value, every reason, every set, worked cases. |

## Running the tool

Every command runs the `qmd-prover` engine, installed once on the host's `PATH`. This skill supplies
the instructions; the engine is a separate command. Invoke it from the project root:

```bash
qmd-prover <command> [arguments]
```

If `qmd-prover` is not found, the engine is not installed yet. Install it once per host, and it is
then available in every project:

```bash
# From a checkout of github.com/powergiant/qmd-prover:
npm install -g .        # puts the `qmd-prover` command on PATH, backed by this checkout
npm link                # equivalent — npm links a local folder either way
```

Both forms symlink the checkout rather than copying it, so the folder must stay where it is, and
`npm run build` must be rerun after editing `src/`. For a standalone copy that does not depend on
the checkout, install the packed tarball instead: `npm install -g "$(npm pack)"`.

Installing the skill is a separate, docs-only step. Once the command is on your `PATH` you never
reinstall the engine — `qmd-prover install --global` only **copies the skill documentation**
(`SKILL.md`, `references/`, `agents/`) into `~/.claude/skills/qmd-prover`, so running it again just
refreshes the docs. Add `--codex` for Codex; a bare `qmd-prover install` scopes the copy to the
current project. A skill installed mid-session is not auto-registered by the host — read the printed
`SKILL.md` path to use qmd-prover now, and start a new session for automatic discovery.

`qmd-prover version` confirms the install and prints the tool, schema, verifier-protocol, and
contract versions. `qmd-prover doctor` additionally reports version drift against the current
project.

Complete leaf-command map. Two flags recur in it:

- **`--print`** swaps the JSON for a concise human-readable report. It changes presentation only —
  same selection, same decisions, same diagnostics — so use it when you want to read the result
  yourself, and the default JSON when you need to act on specific fields.
- **`--graph`** adds the full dependency graph (nodes, edges, cycles) inline in the JSON, which is
  otherwise left out because it is large.

```text
version
doctor [--print]
install [--global|-g] [--codex|--claude] [--dir PROJECT]
init [--adopt-existing|--append-contract|--sync-contract]
inspect project [--print] [--graph]
inspect fact @ID [--print] [--graph]
inspect path FILE_OR_FOLDER [--print] [--graph]
dependency dependencies @ID [--print]
dependency reverse dependencies @ID [--print]
dependency impact @ID [--print]
dependency frontier @ID [--print]
dependency path @FROM @TO [--print]
dependency alternative paths @FROM @TO [--limit N] [--max-depth N] [--print]
dependency cycles [--print]
dependency findings [--print]
dependency unused imports [--print]
dependency unused exports [--print]
dependency isolated [--print]
dependency unreachable [--print]
dependency ready [--print]
dependency reused [--limit N] [--print]
dependency search [QUERY] [--kind KIND] [--status STATUS] [--set SET] [--origin ORIGIN] [--path PATH] [graph filters] [--print]
check staleness [--print]
verification list
verification show SUBMISSION_ID
render [--allow-errors]
```

Conventions that hold everywhere:

- JSON is the default output. Only the commands marked `[--print]` above accept that flag; `version`,
  `install`, `init`, `verification list`, `verification show`, and `render` emit JSON only. `--graph`
  is accepted only by the three `inspect` commands.
- The JSON is lean: every fact appears as `{id, kind, status, file, line}`, and listings carry
  counts. Drill into `inspect fact @ID` for per-fact detail, or pass `--graph` for the whole
  dependency graph (which is also always written to `.qmd-prover/graph.json`).
- A dependency query returns only its own answer — target, dependencies, path, matches — never the
  whole graph.
- Semantic IDs accept either `@ID` or bare `ID`; output normalizes them to `@ID`.
- `ok` reports only that the operation ran without infrastructure errors. It is never a mathematical
  claim. Read `global_verification.status`.
- Exit 1 is a usage error; exit 2 is a valid result with `ok: false`.
- `qmd-prover help COMMAND...` prints exact usage for any command.

Translate this JSON into ordinary language for the user. Do not make them memorize commands.

### Version compatibility

The engine and each project carry versions independently: the installed `qmd-prover` implements a
schema, verifier-protocol, and contract version, while a project's `.qmd-prover/` state and its
`AGENTS.md` contract block were written by whatever engine last touched them. When they differ, the
tool prints a `qmd-prover: warning:` line to stderr before running a project command, and
`qmd-prover doctor` lists the same under a `compatibility` array. These are advisory — the command
still runs; the tool never refuses on a version mismatch. Relay a warning to the user and resolve it:

- **schema** — a stale snapshot; it is ignored and rebuilt on the next `qmd-prover inspect project`.
- **verifier-protocol** — affected cached proof decisions are re-verified on the next inspection.
- **contract** — the project's `AGENTS.md` managed block predates the engine's; review the difference
  and, only with user approval, run `qmd-prover init --sync-contract`.

## Basic project structure

A qmd-prover project is one folder. Everything in it is one unified dependency graph.

```text
my-project/
  AGENTS.md              the project contract (managed block) + local project rules
  _quarto.yml            the book layout: chapter list and render output directory
  index.qmd              the book landing page
  completeness.md        the user's rough note, if any
  completeness.qmd       the user's protected main goal(s)
  workspace/             agent-created mathematics, by convention
    foundations.qmd
    semantics.qmd
    henkin.qmd
    main-proof.qmd       the linked proof of the main goal
  .qmd-prover/           tool state: config.yml, .external.qmd, caches, graph, snapshots
```

What matters about this layout:

- **Every QMD file in the project is semantic mathematics**, wherever it sits. Folders are
  organization for humans, never a semantic boundary. Imports and citations work identically across
  any layout.
- **New agent work goes under a `workspace/` folder** in the project root by convention: definitions,
  intermediate results, proof attempts, calculations, examples, counterexamples, and progress notes.
  Organize it by theme, by goal, or flat, as the argument demands, and follow any folder rules in
  local project policy.
- **Protected main goals stay in the user's file.** qmd-prover registers and protects
  `thm-main-* .theorem .goal` blocks wherever they appear; their statements are locked and must never
  be edited. Put the goal's linked proof in an overlay file such as `workspace/main-proof.qmd`
  without repeating the protected theorem. A goal with no proof yet is simply `open` — proving it
  needs no setup step.
- **Edit pre-existing user files cautiously**, and only as the developing mathematics requires.
- **`.qmd-prover/` is tool state.** Three files in it are authored inputs you may edit —
  `config.yml`, `.external.qmd`, `statement-locks.json`; everything else is regenerated.

The complete rules for declarations, proofs, imports, exports, and conduct are in
[references/AGENTS.md](references/AGENTS.md). Two that are easy to get wrong:

- Any fact may cite any other project fact, including a protected main goal, subject to import scope.
  Global composition keeps dependents blocked until the cited fact is globally verified.
- Never copy a proof, a refutation, or the engine-written `status` attribute into a protected
  statement.

## Project setup

Two commands set a project up. **`doctor`** is read-only and answers "is the environment usable?" —
it checks Node, Pandoc, the optional verifier, and optional Quarto, reports the exact path resolved
for each, and reports version drift. **`init`** answers "is this project a qmd-prover project?" — it
inventories what already exists and writes the canonical contract block into the root `AGENTS.md`.
`init` never creates a theorem and never edits mathematics.

Run `doctor` first whenever tool availability is uncertain:

```bash
qmd-prover doctor --print
```

Then initialize from the project root:

```bash
qmd-prover init
```

Read the returned `existing` inventory and act on the `status`:

| `status` | What it means | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| `created` | Nothing existed; the contract was written. | Continue. |
| `adopted` / `appended` / `synchronized` | A mutation flag you were authorized to use succeeded. | Continue. |
| `already-initialized` | The canonical block is already present. | Setup is current; continue with the user's task. |
| `intent-required` | Project material exists but `AGENTS.md` is missing or empty. Nothing was written. | Summarize the detected `AGENTS.md`, QMD files, Quarto config, `.qmd-prover` state, and external-policy mode, then ask whether to adopt in place, inspect first, or leave unchanged. Run `init --adopt-existing` only after the user chooses adoption. |
| `append-required` | `AGENTS.md` exists without the contract. Nothing was written. | Explain that existing policy will be preserved, then ask before `init --append-contract`. |
| `sync-required` | A different contract version is present. | Report the current and canonical versions, then ask before `init --sync-contract`. |
| `malformed-contract` | Duplicate or unbalanced contract markers. | No flag fixes this; repair `AGENTS.md` by hand. |

Stop and ask before creating, appending, or synchronizing project policy. Never use a mutation flag
without explicit approval. No QMD scaffold or initial theorem is required.

Every outcome that writes also scaffolds `.qmd-prover/` and, when the project has no Quarto
configuration at all, a `_quarto.yml` rendering the project as a book into `.qmd-prover/site/book`.
`quarto_config.status` reports `created` or `preserved`; an existing Quarto configuration is never
touched or merged. The chapter list in that file is the project's to maintain — see
[Rendering](#rendering).

### Environment and verifier setup

Configure anything `doctor` reports missing through `.qmd-prover/config.yml` (or environment
variables) — you never edit qmd-prover's own code. Every setting is documented in
[references/config.md](references/config.md).

**Pandoc (required) and Quarto (optional, only for final render).** Record any path the tool cannot
find on `PATH`:

```yaml
tools:
  pandoc: /absolute/path/to/pandoc
  quarto: /absolute/path/to/quarto
```

`QMD_PROVER_PANDOC` and `QMD_PROVER_QUARTO` also work and take precedence. Leave a value blank to
fall back to `PATH`.

**Decide the verifier up front.** As an early step, decide whether proofs will be independently
checked, and set a backend *before* your first inspection:

```yaml
verification:
  backend: claude        # or: codex
  executable: ""         # path to the claude/codex CLI; blank uses PATH
  model: ""              # "" lets the CLI use its own default model
  effort: high           # low | medium | high | xhigh | max
```

qmd-prover ships the `claude` and `codex` adapters, so no external verifier script is needed. The
selected CLI must be installed and authenticated. Re-run `doctor` until the verifier reads
`available`, then `inspect` calls it automatically. For a bespoke verifier, set `backend: command`
with a `verification.command` argv, or point `QMD_PROVER_VERIFIER` at an executable that speaks the
protocol in [references/cli.md](references/cli.md).

Leaving `backend: none` is a deliberate machine-only choice: local checks stay `not-run` and every
fact stays `unverified`. It is supported, but it is not a default to drift into, and it is never work
you may call verified. Only a configured, available verifier produces verification state. Never
declare your own work verified.

Each check costs real time and tokens, and higher `effort` costs more. Changing any of `backend`,
`model`, `effort`, `fresh-context`, `citations`, `rigor`, `rigor-disprove`, or `tools` re-keys the
cache and re-verifies **every** fact, so switch deliberately rather than per run.

### Project contract preflight

Before drafting mathematics, changing qmd-prover state, or relying on a project fact:

1. Read the project's root `AGENTS.md` and this skill's

## Checking your work: `inspect`

`inspect` is the debugger. It compiles the project into one graph, runs the mechanical checks, sends
whatever is ready to the verifier, composes the global result, and publishes a snapshot. Run it after
each coherent semantic-QMD edit, using the narrowest scope that covers what you changed:

```bash
qmd-prover inspect fact @lem-henkin-witness   # one fact and its transitive dependency closure
qmd-prover inspect path workspace/henkin.qmd  # every fact declared under a file or folder
qmd-prover inspect project                    # every fact in the project
```

| Scope | Checks | Use it for |
|---|---|---|
| `inspect fact @ID` | The named fact plus its transitive local dependencies. Reverse dependencies and unrelated facts are not checked. Returns the full per-fact detail, including the verifier report, dependency lists, blockers, and past verdicts. | Iterating on one result. |
| `inspect path FILE_OR_FOLDER` | Every fact declared under that file or folder, plus their transitive dependencies. | Iterating on one part of the argument. |
| `inspect project` | Every fact. Returns the dashboard: summary, goals, one status row per fact, blockers, finding counts, verification totals, diagnostics. | Deliberate whole-project audits. |

Both narrow scopes leave every ready fact outside their closure `unverified` with reason
`out-of-scope` — that is not a problem, just an unchecked fact. Add `--print` for a human report,
`--graph` to include the dependency graph inline.

# 大 N 非凸排除待审详细证明稿

本稿将[第二份对话](https://chatgpt.com/share/6ae5f5c1-73a4-83e8-8ebb-305149ece080)中声称完成的大 N 论证，整理为一条连续的详细证明链。第 5、8 节已补写乘子、余项、模态面积、弧长及驻点矩的具体推导；第 2.4、3.4 节补写它们依赖的分析入口。本稿仍是待审研究证明稿，尚未经独立核验。第 11 节逐项区分原文省略点、本次新增推导、标准外部输入和仍未覆盖的结论。主命题范围限于边长非零、无自接触、有效内角严格介于 0 与 2π 之间的普通简单多边形。

## 1. 主命题及证明结构

设 P 是恰有 N 条有效边的有界简单多边形。有效边不计相邻共线的冗余节点。记

\[
J(P)=|P|\lambda_1(P),\qquad
m_k=\inf_{\#\mathrm{eff.edges}(Q)\le k}J(Q),
\qquad R_k=\text{正 }k\text{ 边形}.
\tag{1.1}
\]

“驻点”指 J 关于全部原顶点坐标的导数为零，等价于固定面积下 λ₁ 的驻点。

**主命题 A（原对话主张 待核验）。** 存在一个与 P 的角度、最小边长、凹角数及预顶点间距无关的 N₀，使得 N≥N₀ 时，普通简单 N 边形若为驻点且

\[
J(P)\le J(R_{N-1}),
\tag{1.2}
\]

则 P 必凸。特别地，不存在 J(P)<m_{N−1} 的此类非凸驻点。

下面把证明分为两个层次：首先排除满足 J(P)≤J(R_N) 的非凸驻点，从而处理普通全局极小候选；再补上单反角的删除引理，得到更强的式 (1.2)。第二层不能省略。

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[逐边驻点矩] --> B[Airy 四次恒等式]
  B --> C[统一 W1,4 与近圆内包含]
  C --> D[保形面积余量 S 趋零]
  D --> E[统一谱展开给 S 为 N 的负三次方阶]
  B --> F[逆导数能量 T 小于等于常数乘 S]
  E --> G[有符号转角测度的真实谱下界]
  F --> G
  H[Toeplitz 正原子个数下界] --> G
  G --> I[全局极小候选的非凸排除]
  G --> J[至少两个反角的低阈值排除]
  K[单反角驻点矩给小正原子] --> L[删除代价低于边数谱间隙]
  G --> L
  L --> M[单反角低阈值排除]
  J --> N[大 N 主命题]
  M --> N
```

核心尺度是：近圆面积余量 S=O(N⁻³)，非线性谱误差为 O(N⁻⁹ᐟ²√logN)，而少一个凸角造成的比较间隙为正的 N⁻⁴ 阶。误差必须是对全部角度与节点配置一致的，才能得出无几何附加条件的 N₀。

## 2. 驻点条件与 Airy 四次恒等式

### 2.1 每条实际边的两个矩

令 A=|P|、λ=λ₁(P)，u>0 为归一化基态：

\[
-\Delta u=\lambda u,\qquad u\in H_0^1(P),\qquad
\int_Pu^2=1,\qquad c=\lambda/A,
\quad q=|\partial_\nu u|^2.
\]

Hadamard 公式为

\[
DJ(P)[V]=A\int_{\partial P}(c-q)V\cdot\nu\,ds.
\tag{2.1}
\]

原顶点速度在每条实际边上产生仿射法向速度。相邻有效边法向线性独立，故驻点给出逐边

\[
\boxed{\int_E(q-c)ds=0,\qquad
\int_Es(q-c)ds=0.}
\tag{2.2}
\]

s 是该边从任一端点起的物理弧长。归一化到 x∈[0,1]，即 ∫q=c、∫xq=c/2。

### 2.2 校准应力的势函数

采用原对话的半应力记号

\[
\mathbf T=\nabla u\otimes\nabla u
-\tfrac12(|\nabla u|^2-\lambda u^2)I,
\qquad \operatorname{div}\mathbf T=0.
\]

取 Airy 势 ψ 满足 D²ψ=RᵀTR，其中 R 旋转 90°；再令 Φ=ψ−c|x|²/4。其 Hessian 为

\[
D^2\Phi=\tfrac12(|\nabla u|^2+\lambda u^2-c)I
-\nabla u\otimes\nabla u.
\tag{2.3}
\]

在开边上 Φₜₜ=(q−c)/2、Φνₜ=0。由第一矩中的零阶式，∇Φ 在一条边两端相同，沿所有边传播后可减去一个仿射函数，使它在全部顶点为零。因此 ∂νΦ=0 于全部开边。

角点内角 ω<2π，α=π/ω>1/2，基态首模态为 arᵅsin(αθ)。所以 |∇u|⁴=O(r⁴ᵅ⁻⁴) 在二维可积，切去小角弧后的二阶散度余项也趋零。利用

\[
\operatorname{div}\{\Delta\Phi\nabla\Phi-D^2\Phi\nabla\Phi\}
=(\Delta\Phi)^2-|D^2\Phi|^2,
\]

以及边上 ∂νΦ=0、混合 Hessian 项为零，得到 Hessian 行列式积分为零。D²Φ 的特征值是 (λu²−c±|∇u|²)/2，故

\[
\boxed{\int_P|\nabla u|^4
=\lambda^2\left(\int_Pu^4-A^{-1}\right).}
\tag{2.4}
\]

这条恒等式没有使用近圆性，也没有限制凹角数量。

### 2.3 几何无关的正则性

热核估计给 ∥u∥∞²≤e²λ/(8π)。式 (2.4) 因而推出

\[
\int_P|\nabla u|^4\le\frac{e^2\lambda^3}{8\pi}.
\tag{2.5}
\]

当面积固定、λ 有界时，零延拓的 u 在全平面统一有 W¹,⁴ 界及 C⁰,¹ᐟ² 界。这里各 P 的角点虽可任意接近退化值，但估计常数不使用角度下界。

### 2.4 角点截断与顶点形状导数的技术说明

**原文未展开处。** 原文从 α=π/ω>1/2 直接跳到角点边界项消失，没有列出所需的梯度界、Airy 梯度的顶点极限及误差阶。以下补写这些接口。这里先固定一个普通多边形；局部角点常数允许依赖该多边形。先对每个域取得精确恒等式，再从恒等式得到统一界，不要求角点截断速度在整个多边形类中统一。

在某个顶点的扇形邻域 0<r<R、0<θ<ω 中，齐次 Helmholtz–Dirichlet 方程可按角变量的正弦基展开。令 α=π/ω，取 R 足够小使 √λR≤1，则有限能量解具有

\[
u(r,\theta)=\sum_{m\ge1}b_m
\frac{J_{m\alpha}(\sqrt\lambda r)}
{J_{m\alpha}(\sqrt\lambda R)}\sin(m\alpha\theta).
\tag{2.A1}
\]

bₘ 是 u(R,·) 的正弦系数。有限 H¹ 能量排除了 r⁻ᵐᵅ 型的第二支解。Bessel 幂级数在 √λR≤1 时给出分母非零、以及 r≤R/2 上的几何衰减界；与 Σ|bₘ|²<∞ 联用，可逐项求导并得到

\[
|u(r,\theta)|\le C_Pr^\alpha,
\qquad |\nabla u(r,\theta)|\le C_Pr^{\alpha-1}.
\tag{2.A2}
\]

这也是标准扇形角点展开的特例；一般背景见 [Dauge 关于角点正则性与 Helmholtz 展开的讲义](https://perso.univ-rennes1.fr/monique.dauge/publis/Talk_Karlsruhe08.pdf)。本稿此处只使用直边、常系数、齐次 Dirichlet 情形。

先说明顶点移动的 Hadamard 公式。将给定顶点速度在固定三角剖分上线性延拓为 Lipschitz 速度 V。映射 I+tV 在 t 足够小时是可逆的小扰动。把 Rayleigh 商拉回固定域，并对简单特征值微分，给出体积分公式

\[
\lambda'[V]=\int_P\bigl[
(\operatorname{div}V)(|\nabla u|^2-\lambda u^2)
-2\nabla u\cdot DV\nabla u\bigr]
=-2\int_P\mathbf T:DV.
\tag{2.A3}
\]

在切去各顶点小扇形后的域上，div T=0 可以通常方式分部积分。小圆弧上 T=O(r²ᵅ⁻²)+O(1)，V 有界，故该弧的应力通量绝对值至多 C_P(r²ᵅ⁻¹+r)→0。开边上 Tν=qν/2；同时 q=O(r²ᵅ⁻²) 沿边可积，因为 α>1/2。因此式 (2.A3) 的极限正是 λ′=−∫∂PqV·ν，进而得到式 (2.1)。

在每个顶点，驻点条件是两个相邻边法向量的线性组合为零。有效顶点的两法向线性独立，故这两个系数分别为零；系数恰是相邻边上仿射帽函数与 c−q 的积分。对一条边的两个端点分别使用该结论，便得到其两个帽函数矩为零；相加、线性组合即为式 (2.2)。这说明逐边两个矩并非把不同边上的允许速度错误地当成彼此独立。

再说明 Airy 梯度的顶点极限。由式 (2.3)、(2.A2)，

\[
|D^2\Phi|\le C_P(r^{2\alpha-2}+1).
\tag{2.A4}
\]

沿径向积分可得 ∇Φ 的极限；沿半径 r 的扇形圆弧比较不同方向，差值至多 C_P(r²ᵅ⁻¹+r)→0，因此这是同一个顶点极限。相应地

\[
\nabla\Phi(x)-G_{\rm vertex}
=O_P(r^{2\alpha-1}+r).
\tag{2.A5}
\]

由各边零阶矩，这些顶点极限沿全边界相同。减去全局仿射函数后，可令全部 G_vertex=0。

对 B=(ΔΦ)∇Φ−D²Φ∇Φ，直边上的 B·ν=0，因为 ∂νΦ=0、Φνt=0。小圆弧上的通量由式 (2.A4)–(2.A5) 估计为

\[
\int_{\text{小圆弧}}|B\cdot\nu|ds
\le C_Pr(r^{2\alpha-2}+1)(r^{2\alpha-1}+r)
\le C_P(r^{4\alpha-2}+r^{2\alpha}+r^2)\longrightarrow0.
\tag{2.A6}
\]

同时 |∇u|⁴ 的角点积分为 O_P(∫₀ᴿr⁴ᵅ⁻³dr)<∞，因此可以对 div B 积分后取极限，得到式 (2.4)。特别是角度趋近 2π 时，截断幂次可以趋零，但每个固定域的极限仍为零；精确恒等式中不留下一个随角度爆炸的误差常数。

**技术输入的界线。** 上述说明使用有限能量扇形解的正弦–Bessel 展开、固定域简单特征值的材料微分、以及 Lipschitz 小扰动的标准性质；未重新证明这些基础定理的一般版本。它们与本稿新补的具体误差估计应分开核验，不能只引用光滑域的边界公式而跳过角点截断。

## 3. 保形归一化及低能推出 S 至多为 N⁻³ 阶

### 3.1 最大保形半径规范

以最大保形半径点为 Riemann 映射中心，再缩放和旋转，使

\[
F:\mathbb D\to P,\qquad F'(0)=1,\quad F''(0)=0.
\tag{3.1}
\]

第二个等式来自最大保形半径的一阶临界条件：圆盘参数 a 下，保形半径是 (1−|a|²)|F′(a)|，在 a=0 微分即得 F″(0)=0。

记

\[
f=F'=1+g,\quad g(z)=\sum_{n\ge2}g_nz^n,
\qquad
S=\|g\|_{A^2}^2=\frac1\pi\int_{\mathbb D}|g|^2
=\sum_{n\ge2}\frac{|g_n|^2}{n+1}.
\tag{3.2}
\]

面积公式精确给出 A=π(1+S)。以下以

\[
\mathcal J(P)=\frac{J(P)}{\pi j^2},\qquad j=j_{0,1},
\tag{3.3}
\]

表示相对于圆盘的无量纲谱值。J 和 S 都不受最初整体缩放的影响。

### 3.2 先证明 S 趋零，再使用小 S 展开

由式 (1.2) 及正多边形渐近，面积归一化为 π 后 λ(P)−j²=O(N⁻³)。定量 Faber–Krahn 给平移后 |P△D|→0。

这一面积收敛本身不排除裂缝；这里使用第 2 节的驻点 W¹,⁴ 界。基态在固定紧集上子列一致收敛；由统一 L∞ 界，圆盘外 L² 质量趋零。极限属于 H₀¹(D)、L² 范数为 1、能量不超过 j²，故只能为圆盘归一化正基态 u₀。

于是任意 η>0，最终 B₁₋η⊂P。否则取缺失点 x_N∈B₁₋η\P，零延拓 u_N(x_N)=0，与 u₀ 在该闭圆盘严格正及一致收敛矛盾。

面积 π 规范下，最大保形半径 r_P 至少为 1−η，至多为 1。换到式 (3.1) 的规范，1+S=r_P⁻²，因此 S→0。这个顺序避免了先用小 S 展开反过来假定 S 已小的循环。

## 4. 用驻点恒等式控制逆保形导数

### 4.1 逆导数的 Bergman 能量

令

\[
k=f^{-1}-1,\qquad T=\|k\|_{A^2}^2.
\tag{4.1}
\]

f 在 D 内不为零。反角的 SC 权重为 −v、0<v<1/2，局部 f∼(z−ζ)²ᵛ，所以 |f⁻¹|² 的二维积分有限。故每个普通多边形的 T 有限，但尚无统一上界。

将式 (2.4) 拉回圆盘，得到

\[
\int_D|\nabla v|^4|1+k|^2
=\lambda^2\int_Dv^4|1+g|^2
-\frac{\lambda^2}{\pi(1+S)}.
\tag{4.2}
\]

记 a(r)=|∇v₀(r)|⁴，b₁=4|∇v₀|²∇v₀·∇v₁。式 (3.6) 给 |∇v|⁴=a+b₁+O(S)。径向 a 与解析零常数项 k 正交，且 b₁ 的圆周均值为零，于是左边为

\[
\int_Da+\int_Da|k|^2
+O(\sqrt S\sqrt T+\sqrt S\,T+S(1+T)).
\tag{4.3}
\]

右边的一阶项也因 Fourier 正交消失，等于 ∫a+O(S)。a 在一个固定外环上有正下界；内圆盘上 g=O(√S)，故 k=−g/(1+g)=O(√S)。因此

\[
T\le C\{S+\sqrt S\sqrt T+\sqrt S\,T+ST\}.
\]

用 Young 不等式控制 √S√T，并在 S 足够小时吸收另外两项，得到

\[
\boxed{T\le CS.}
\tag{4.4}
\]

这一推导不要求负转角总量小，也不要求反角与 2π 保持统一距离。

### 4.2 对数能量的正确单侧比较

令 L=logf，取 L(0)=0。由解析函数均值性质，S+T=π⁻¹∫(|f|²+|f⁻¹|²−2)。又

\[
|f|^2+|f^{-1}|^2-2
=2\cosh(2\operatorname{Re}L)-2
\ge4(\operatorname{Re}L)^2.
\]

L 的常数项为零，故其实名与虚部的 Bergman 能量相等，从而

\[
\boxed{\|L\|_{A^2}^2\le(S+T)/2.}
\tag{4.5}
\]

这里只是单侧不等式。不能把 f−1 与 logf 在普通 A² 范数中直接视为误差足够小的同一变量。

## 5. 核心统一非线性谱下界的详细推导

本节把实际谱展开中的 g=f−1 转换为 L=logf 的正二次型。困难在于：小 Bergman 范数并不给出 f 或 f⁻¹ 的一致点值小量，不能直接把 k=f⁻¹−1 当成 −g 加上普通 A² 意义下的二阶小量。正确做法是先独立展开 (g,k)，再只在具有额外频率衰减的项中使用逆关系。

**原文状态。** 原对话给出了下列替换、径向乘子、梯度像面积的计算路线，但没有写出全部估计。本节补写这些计算；所用谱分支及角点恒等式分别以第 3 节和第 2 节为输入。它们的技术适用性在第 11 节单列，不能由本节倒推。

### 5.1 带频率衰减的替换引理

所有 Aᵖ 范数均用归一化面积测度 dA/π。记

\[
\mathcal E(S)=S^{3/2}\sqrt{\log(e/S)},\qquad 0<S<s_0<1.
\tag{5.3}
\]

先证明一个通用分频估计。若解析函数 D(z)=Σₙ≥₂Dₙzⁿ 满足

\[
\|D\|_{A^1}\le C_1S,\qquad
\|D\|_{A^2}^2\le C_2S,
\tag{5.A1}
\]

则系数面积积分公式给出

\[
D_n=\frac{n+1}{\pi}\int_D D(z)\overline z^{\,n}dA(z),
\qquad |D_n|\le C_1(n+1)S.
\]

取 K=⌈S⁻¹ᐟ²⌉。低频部分和高频部分分别满足

\[
\begin{aligned}
\sum_{2\le n\le K}\frac{|D_n|^2}{(n+1)^3}
&\le C_1^2S^2\sum_{2\le n\le K}\frac1{n+1}
\le CS^2\log(e/S),\\
\sum_{n>K}\frac{|D_n|^2}{(n+1)^3}
&\le (K+1)^{-2}\sum_{n>K}\frac{|D_n|^2}{n+1}
\le CS^2.
\end{aligned}
\tag{5.A2}
\]

对 D₁=g+k=−gk，由 T≤CS 及 Hölder 不等式，

\[
\|D_1\|_{A^1}\le\|g\|_{A^2}\|k\|_{A^2}\le CS,
\qquad
\|D_1\|_{A^2}^2\le2(S+T)\le CS.
\]

这里第二个界使用 D₁=g+k，而不是把乘积 gk 直接当成有界 A² 乘法。因此

\[
\boxed{\sum_{n\ge2}\frac{|g_n+k_n|^2}{(n+1)^3}
\le CS^2\log(e/S).}
\tag{5.1}
\]

若实乘子满足 |bₙ|≤C_b/(n+1)²，则利用精确代数式

\[
|k_n|^2-|g_n|^2
=\operatorname{Re}\{(k_n+g_n)\overline{(k_n-g_n)}\}
\]

及 Cauchy–Schwarz，得到

\[
\begin{aligned}
\left|\sum_{n\ge2}b_n(|k_n|^2-|g_n|^2)\right|
&\le C_b
\left(\sum\frac{|k_n+g_n|^2}{(n+1)^3}\right)^{1/2}
\left(\sum\frac{|k_n-g_n|^2}{n+1}\right)^{1/2}\\
&\le C\mathcal E(S).
\end{aligned}
\tag{5.2}
\]

对混合项也有同样结论：如果 |mₙ|≤C/(n+1)²，那么

\[
\left|\sum m_n\operatorname{Re}\{g_n\overline{(k_n+g_n)}\}\right|
\le C\mathcal E(S).
\tag{5.A3}
\]

再处理 D₂=L−g。对任意复数 z 都有

\[
|e^z-1-z|\le C\bigl(|e^z-1|^2+|z|^2\bigr).
\tag{5.A4}
\]

证明只需分成 |z|≤1 的 Taylor 余项及 |z|>1 的三角不等式：后者用 |eᶻ−1|+|z|≤C(|eᶻ−1|²+|z|²)。代入 z=L，并使用式 (4.5)，可得 ∥L−g∥A¹≤CS、∥L−g∥A²²≤CS。故同一分频论证给出

\[
\left|\sum b_n(|g_n|^2-|L_n|^2)\right|
\le C\mathcal E(S)
\quad\text{当 }|b_n|\le C_b(n+1)^{-2}.
\tag{5.A5}
\]

以上常数只依赖固定的范数界和乘子常数，不涉及多边形的节点配置。

### 5.2 双变量泛函及其三阶余项

令 v(g)、λ(g) 为第 3 节中在固定圆盘上构造、并满足 ∫v²|1+g|²=1 的正谱分支。定义

\[
\mathscr H(g,k)=
\int_D|\nabla v(g)|^4|1+k|^2
-\lambda(g)^2\int_Dv(g)^4|1+g|^2
+\frac{\lambda(g)^2}{\pi(1+\|g\|_{A^2}^2)}.
\tag{5.4}
\]

暂将 g、k 视为 A² 中两个独立的解析变量，且它们的常数项、一次项均为零。v(g) 在 X=C¹(D̄)∩{零边界值} 中实解析。积分中的因子 |k|²、|g|² 属于 L¹；例如

\[
\left|\int_D a(x)k_1\overline{k_2}\,dA\right|
\le\pi\|a\|_\infty\|k_1\|_{A^2}\|k_2\|_{A^2}.
\]

这说明 H 的各项都是有界多线性映射与解析映射的复合。因此存在固定半径及固定常数，使

\[
\mathscr H(g,k)=H_2(g,k)+R_H(g,k),\qquad
|R_H(g,k)|\le C(\|g\|_{A^2}+\|k\|_{A^2})^3.
\tag{5.A6}
\]

零阶项为零，是因为圆盘满足式 (2.4)；一次项为零，是因为 v₀ 径向，v₁、Re g、Re k 的每个圆周平均均为零，且 λ₁=0。在实际驻点处，式 (4.2) 给 H(g,k)=0，而 T≤CS 将余项统一控制为 O(S³ᐟ²)。此处没有展开映射 g↦(1+g)⁻¹。

为列全二次项，写 λ=j²+λ₂+O(∥g∥³)、v=v₀+v₁+v₂+O_X(∥g∥³)，下标表示齐次阶，不包含额外的阶乘。记

\[
\begin{aligned}
a(r)&=v_0'(r)^4,\qquad p_D=-v_0'(1),\\
b_1(g)&=4|\nabla v_0|^2\nabla v_0\cdot\nabla v_1,\\
a_2(g)&=4|\nabla v_0|^2\nabla v_0\cdot\nabla v_2
+2|\nabla v_0|^2|\nabla v_1|^2
+4(\nabla v_0\cdot\nabla v_1)^2,\\
c_2(g)&=4v_0^3v_2+6v_0^2v_1^2
+8v_0^3v_1\operatorname{Re}g+v_0^4|g|^2.
\end{aligned}
\tag{5.A7}
\]

直接逐项相乘得到

\[
\begin{aligned}
H_2(g,k)&=\pi p_D^4(T-S)+Q_0(g)+A(k)+M(g,k),\\
Q_0(g)&=\int_Da_2-j^4\int_Dc_2
+2j^2\lambda_2\left(\pi^{-1}-\int_Dv_0^4\right),\\
A(k)&=\int_D(a(r)-p_D^4)|k|^2,\\
M(g,k)&=2\int_Db_1(g)\operatorname{Re}k.
\end{aligned}
\tag{5.A8}
\]

其中 πp_D⁴=j⁴/π，负的 S 项恰好来自最后一项中 (1+S)⁻¹=1−S+O(S²)。这列出了全部二次项，未将任何未知的纯 g 项藏入误差。下面通过梯度像面积算出 Q₀(g)+A(−g)+M(g,−g)。

### 5.3 两个径向乘子的明确估计

径向正交性给出

\[
A(k)=\sum_{n\ge2}A_n|k_n|^2,
\quad A_n=2\pi\int_0^1(v_0'(r)^4-p_D^4)r^{2n+1}dr.
\tag{5.A9}
\]

v₀ 是固定圆盘上的光滑函数，且 a(1)=p_D⁴，故 |a(r)−p_D⁴|≤C(1−r)。于是

\[
|A_n|\le2\pi C\int_0^1(1-r)r^{2n+1}dr
=\frac{2\pi C}{(2n+2)(2n+3)}.
\tag{5.A10}

这就是第一个 O(n⁻²) 乘子。第二个乘子需要保留一阶响应内部的抵消。写

\[
v_1(g)=\sum_{n\ge2}w_n(r)\operatorname{Re}(g_ne^{in\theta}),
\quad

\tag{5.A11}
\]

利用 ∫₀²πRe(αeⁱⁿθ)Re(βeⁱᵐθ)dθ=πδₙₘRe(αβ̄)，有

\[
M(g,k)=\sum_{n\ge2}M_n\operatorname{Re}(g_n\overline{k_n}),
\quad M_n=8\pi\int_0^1v_0'(r)^3w_n'(r)r^{n+1}dr.
\tag{5.A12}
\]

下面证明 |Mₙ|≤C/(n+1)³，而不是直接宣称由 Bessel 公式可知。设 σ=j²/4，并令

\[
H_n(s)=\sum_{m\ge0}\frac{(-\sigma s)^m n!}{m!(n+m)!},
\quad
B_n(r)=\frac{H_n(r^2)}{H_n(1)}
=\frac{J_n(jr)}{r^nJ_n(j)}.
\tag{5.A13}
\]

n≥2 时，交错级数给 Hₙ(1)≥1−σ/(n+1)>1/2；逐项绝对估计给 sup₀≤s≤₁|Hₙ′(s)|≤C/(n+1)。所以

\[
|B_n(r)-1|\le\frac{C(1-r)}{n+1},\qquad
|B_n'(r)|\le\frac C{n+1}.
\tag{5.A14}
\]

再设 A₀(r)=rv₀′(r)/p_D。圆盘径向方程 v₀″+r⁻¹v₀′+j²v₀=0 及 v₀(1)=0 给出

\[
A_0(1)=-1,\qquad A_0'(1)=0,
\quad |A_0(r)+1|\le C(1-r)^2,
\quad |A_0'(r)|\le C(1-r).
\tag{5.A15}
\]

因此 wₙ=p_Drⁿ(A₀+Bₙ)/(n+1)，微分后得到统一的边界层界

\[
|w_n'(r)|\le Cr^{n-1}
\left((1-r)^2+\frac{1-r}{n+1}+\frac1{(n+1)^2}\right).
\tag{5.A16}
\]

将其代入式 (5.A12)，再用

\[
\int_0^1r^m(1-r)^\ell dr
=\frac{\ell!}{(m+1)(m+2)\cdots(m+\ell+1)}
\quad(\ell=0,1,2),
\]

可得

\[
|M_n|\le C\int_0^1r^{2n}
\left((1-r)^2+\frac{1-r}{n+1}+\frac1{(n+1)^2}\right)dr
\le\frac C{(n+1)^3}.
\tag{5.A17}
\]

**关键抵消。** A₀(1)+Bₙ(1)=0 且 A₀′(1)=0，使边界层积分比未保留抵消的粗估计多衰减。以上全部常数来自固定 j、固定 v₀ 和 Bessel 级数界。

式 (5.2)、(5.A3) 现在可实际应用于

\[
A(k)+M(g,k)=A(-g)+M(g,-g)+O(\mathcal E(S)).
\tag{5.5}
\]

πp_D⁴T 的乘子只有 πp_D⁴/(n+1)，不满足上述替换条件，必须保留原样。

### 5.4 用梯度像面积计算剩余完整二次型

先固定一个多项式方向 g=azⁿ，n≥2。对足够小实 t，Fₜ′=1+tazⁿ 给出圆盘的光滑单叶变形。因为方向固定且有界，可令 Re Fₜ′>0；沿圆盘内线段积分即可验证单叶性。此处只要求每个固定方向存在自己的小 t 区间，并不要求单叶性半径在 A² 单位球上一致。

令 k(t)=(1+tg)⁻¹−1=−tg+O(t²)。H 的一次项为零，因此

\[
\mathscr H(tg,k(t))=t^2H_2(g,-g)+O_g(t^3).
\tag{5.A18}
\]

下标 g 表示这一步的路径误差可以依赖固定多项式；最后统一余项将使用式 (5.A6)，不使用这一路径误差。

设 pₜ=−∂ᵣvₜ。在 r=1 上，Bessel 递推给

\[
w_n'(1)=-\frac{p_D\rho_n}{n+1},\qquad
\dot p=\frac{p_D\rho_n}{n+1}\operatorname{Re}(ae^{in\theta}).
\tag{5.A19}
\]

物理通量 qₜ=pₜ²/|Fₜ′|²，而 λ̇=0、Ȧ=0，所以 ċ=0。故

\[
\dot q-\dot c=-\frac{2p_D^2\beta_n}{n+1}
\operatorname{Re}(ae^{in\theta}),
\quad \beta_n=n+1-\rho_n.
\tag{5.6}
\]

对每个光滑变形域，取其校准 Airy 势 Φₜ，并记边界梯度像 Γₜ(θ)=∇Φₜ(Fₜ(eⁱθ))，将向量等同于复数。沿边界有

\[
\frac{d\Gamma_t}{d\theta}
=\frac12(q_t-c_t)\,i e^{i\theta}F_t'(e^{i\theta}).
\tag{5.A20}
\]

圆盘上 q₀=c₀=p_D²，故可平移梯度像使 Γ₀=0。先取 a 为实数，并记 d=−2p_D²βₙa/(n+1)。对式 (5.A20) 微分、再积分，有

\[
\dot\Gamma'(\theta)=\frac d2\cos(n\theta)i e^{i\theta},
\qquad
\dot\Gamma(\theta)=\frac d4
\left(\frac{e^{i(n+1)\theta}}{n+1}
+\frac{e^{i(1-n)\theta}}{1-n}\right)
\tag{5.A21}
\]

至多相差一个不影响有向面积的常向量。复曲线 Γ=Σcₖeⁱᵏθ 的有向面积为 πΣk|cₖ|²，所以

\[
\operatorname{Area}_{\rm signed}(\dot\Gamma)
=\frac{\pi d^2}{16}
\left(\frac1{n+1}+\frac1{1-n}\right)
=-\frac{\pi d^2}{8(n^2-1)}.
\tag{5.A22}
\]

另一方面，对任一此类光滑域，直接计算 Hessian 行列式并使用 ∫u²=1，得到

\[
\mathscr H=-4\int_P\det D^2\Phi
=-4\operatorname{Area}_{\rm signed}(\nabla\Phi|_{\partial P}).
\tag{5.A23}
\]

第二个等号是 Stokes 公式；它计算带方向和重数的面积，不要求梯度像曲线简单或梯度映射单叶。因 Γ₀=0，面积的 t² 系数正是式 (5.A22)。故

\[
H_2(az^n,-az^n)
=2\pi p_D^4
\frac{\beta_n^2}{(n+1)^2(n^2-1)}|a|^2.
\tag{5.7}
\]

复 a 的情况由旋转得到。泛函旋转不变，因此其限制 H₂(g,−g) 的实二次型只有 |gₙ|² 项：交叉项 gₙḡₘ 在旋转下有频率 n−m，gₙgₘ 有频率 n+m，除 n=m 的第一类外均不能留下。于是对任意解析多项式

\[
H_2(g,-g)=2\pi p_D^4\sum_{n\ge2}
\frac{\beta_n^2}{(n+1)^2(n^2-1)}|g_n|^2.
\tag{5.A24}
\]

现在说明推广过程。由 0<ρₙ<2，有 0<βₙ<n+1，所以式 (5.A24) 的乘子至多 C/(n+1)²，定义 A² 上连续二次型；左端作为解析泛函的二阶项同样连续。解析多项式在 A² 中稠密，故两者在全部 A² 数据上相等。推广不需要多边形预顶点分离，也不需要逼近多项式的逆导数具有统一范数。

### 5.5 回到真实逆关系并提取 S−T

在真实驻点处，H(g,k)=0。由式 (5.A6)、(5.A8)、(5.5)、(5.A24)，

\[
0=\pi p_D^4(T-S)
+2\pi p_D^4\sum_{n\ge2}
\frac{\beta_n^2}{(n+1)^2(n^2-1)}|g_n|^2
+O(\mathcal E(S)).
\]

除以固定正数 πp_D⁴，得到

\[
\boxed{S-T=2\sum_{n\ge2}
\frac{\beta_n^2}{(n+1)^2(n^2-1)}|g_n|^2
+O(\mathcal E(S)).}
\tag{5.8}
\]

这里统一常数来自三个可追踪的界：固定圆盘谱分支的三阶余项、T≤CS、式 (5.A10) 和 (5.A17) 的乘子估计。不是由光滑单叶路径的 t 区间取得。

### 5.6 得到对数转角的正二次型

令 dₙ=βₙ²/[(n+1)²(n²−1)]，rₙ=ρₙ/(n+1)²。式 (4.5) 给 S≥∥L∥A²²+(S−T)/2。代入实际谱展开式 (3.9)，得到

\[
\mathcal J(P)\ge1+\|L\|_{A^2}^2
+\sum_{n\ge2}(d_n-r_n)|g_n|^2-C\mathcal E(S).
\tag{5.A25}
\]

dₙ=O(n⁻²)，rₙ=O(n⁻³)，故式 (5.A5) 可将最后的 g 换成 L。注意被替换的只有 dₙ−rₙ，未替换主范数的 O(n⁻¹) 乘子。整理系数即得

\[
\boxed{\mathcal J(P)\ge
1+\sum_{n\ge2}\gamma_n|L_n|^2-C\mathcal E(S),}
\tag{5.9}
\]

\[
\gamma_n=\frac1{n+1}-\frac{\rho_n}{(n+1)^2}
+\frac{\beta_n^2}{(n+1)^2(n^2-1)}
=\frac{\beta_n}{(n+1)^2}
\left(1+\frac{\beta_n}{n^2-1}\right)>0.
\tag{5.10}

\]

但

\[
4\zeta(3)\{(N-1)^{-3}-N^{-3}\}
=12\zeta(3)N^{-4}+O(N^{-5}),
\tag{7.3}
\]

严格压过全部 o(N⁻⁴) 误差，N 足够大时矛盾。

因此，在核心谱引理的一致性成立的前提下，普通简单多边形类中，充分大 N 的非凸驻点不可能满足 J(P)≤J(R_N)。普通的 N 边全局极小候选是驻点，并且可与 R_N 比较，所以它必凸。此处没有假设 R_N 已经在非凸类中最优。

## 8. 单反角附加引理的详细推导

第 7 节用 p≤N−1 排除阈值 J(R_N)。若参考值改为 J(R_{N−1})，唯一反角情形恰有 p=N−1，离散下界的首项与参考值相同。必须额外从真实驻点条件找到一个足够小的正原子，然后在第 9 节的离散能量中删除它。

### 8.1 直边约束给出预顶点弧长上界

令 H(z)=F(z)−F(0)−z。由式 (3.2)，

\[
H(z)=\sum_{n\ge2}\frac{g_n}{n+1}z^{n+1}.
\]

定义圆周上的齐次半范数

\[
\mathcal Q(H)=\int_0^{2\pi}\int_0^{2\pi}
\frac{|H(e^{i\theta})-H(e^{i\varphi})|^2}
{|e^{i\theta}-e^{i\varphi}|^2}\,d\theta d\varphi.
\tag{8.A1}
\]

单个模式 eⁱᵏθ 的双积分等于 4π²|k|；由 Fourier 正交性及有限 Dirichlet 能量的逼近，精确得到

\[
\mathcal Q(H)=4\pi^2\sum_{n\ge2}\frac{|g_n|^2}{n+1}
=4\pi^2S.
\tag{8.A2}
\]

设 I 是某条实际边对应的预顶点弧，长度为 ε。取该直线单位法向 ν。因为 ν·F(eⁱθ) 在 I 上为常数，

\[
\nu\cdot H(e^{i\theta})=\text{常数}-\nu\cdot e^{i\theta}.
\tag{8.A3}
\]

将弧中点移至参数 t=0，并写 ν·eⁱ⁽θ₀₊ₜ⁾=A cos t+B sin t，A²+B²=1。先设 ε≤1，t,s∈[−ε/2,ε/2]。由于 |eⁱᵗ−eⁱˢ|≤|t−s|，把式 (8.A1) 限制到 I×I，再投影到 ν，得到下界

\[
\int_{-\varepsilon/2}^{\varepsilon/2}
\int_{-\varepsilon/2}^{\varepsilon/2}
\frac{|A(\cos t-\cos s)+B(\sin t-\sin s)|^2}{(t-s)^2}\,dt ds.
\tag{8.A4}
\]

同时令 (t,s)↦(−t,−s)，余弦差不变、正弦差变号，故积分中的混合项为零。又有

\[
\frac{\sin t-\sin s}{t-s}
=\cos\frac{t+s}2\,\operatorname{sinc}\frac{t-s}2,
\quad
\frac{\cos t-\cos s}{t-s}
=-\sin\frac{t+s}2\,\operatorname{sinc}\frac{t-s}2,
\]

其中 sinc x=sin x/x。在 ε≤1 的范围内，第一式绝对值有固定正下界，第二式平方至少为 c(t+s)²。因此式 (8.A4) 至少为

\[
cB^2\varepsilon^2+cA^2
\int_{-\varepsilon/2}^{\varepsilon/2}
\int_{-\varepsilon/2}^{\varepsilon/2}(t+s)^2dt ds
=cB^2\varepsilon^2+\frac c6A^2\varepsilon^4
\ge c'\varepsilon^4.
\tag{8.A5}
\]

若 ε>1，取弧内长度为 1 的子弧，同样得到 S≥c₀>0。因此 S 足够小时，每条预顶点弧均≤1，并由式 (8.A2)、(8.A5) 得到

\[
\boxed{\Delta:=\max_i|I_i|\le CS^{1/4}.}
\tag{8.1}
\]

这个结论是最大间距上界；它允许任意小的最小间距。

### 8.2 圆盘边界导数的局部振荡

记 p(θ)=−∂ᵣv(eⁱθ)。第 3 节在 X 中的二阶展开给

\[
p=p_D+p_1+R_p,\qquad \|R_p\|_\infty\le CS.
\tag{8.A6}
\]

由式 (5.A19)，一阶项的精确表示为

\[
p_1(\theta)=p_D\sum_{n\ge2}
\frac{\rho_n}{n+1}\operatorname{Re}(g_ne^{in\theta}).
\tag{8.A7}
\]

Bessel 交错级数给 ρₙ≤C/(n+1)。于是对 |t|≤ε≤1，系数 Cauchy–Schwarz 给

\[
\begin{aligned}
|p_1(\theta+t)-p_1(\theta)|
&\le C\sqrt S
\left(\sum_{n\ge2}
\frac{\min(n^2t^2,4)}{(n+1)^3}\right)^{1/2}\\
&\le C\sqrt S\,\varepsilon\sqrt{\log(e/\varepsilon)}.
\end{aligned}
\tag{8.A8}
\]

最后一步在 n≈1/|t| 处分频：低频为 Ct²Σₙ≤₁/|t|1/n，高频为 CΣₙ>₁/|t|n⁻³≤Ct²。因此

\[
\operatorname{osc}_Ip
\le C\left[\sqrt S\,\varepsilon\sqrt{\log(e/\varepsilon)}+S\right].
\tag{8.2}
\]

同样的 Cauchy–Schwarz（不取差分）给 ∥p₁∥∞≤C√S，故 S 小时 p≥p_D/2。结合 ε≤CS¹ᐟ⁴，得到每条边对应弧上的统一估计

\[
\boxed{\operatorname{osc}_Ip\le C\eta,
\qquad \eta=S^{3/4}\sqrt{\log(e/S)}.}
\tag{8.3}
\]

其中 S 项已被 η 吸收。这一步控制的是圆盘上的 p，物理通量还要除以 |f|；不能直接把 p 的振荡误认为物理 q 的振荡。

### 8.3 唯一负原子的 cot 场及选边

将唯一负原子旋转到 θ=0，权重记为 −b，0<b<1/2；其余权重为 aⱼ∈(0,1/2)，预顶点依次位于 (0,2π)。这里用 b 表示负质量，避免与谱状态 v 混淆。令

\[
\ell(\theta)=\log|f(e^{i\theta})|,
\quad x=\cot(\theta/2),\quad x_j=\cot(\theta_j/2),
\quad C_*:=\sum_ja_jx_j.
\]

\[
\ell'(\theta)
=b\cot\frac\theta2-\sum_ja_j\cot\frac{\theta-\theta_j}2.
\tag{8.A9}
\]

利用初等恒等式

\[
-\c…4159 tokens truncated…rname{Re}(ae^{in\theta}),
\qquad p_D=j/\sqrt\pi.
$$
The induced first-order Airy gradient has frequencies $n+1$ and $1-n$; its signed area is $-\pi d_n^2/[8(n^2-1)]$. Since the Airy identity equals minus four times this area, the quadratic contribution is
$$

Rotational orthogonality removes cross terms, and density of analytic polynomials extends the calculation to $A^2$. The actual relation $g+k=-gk$ then gives

$$
\frac{J(P)}{\pi j^2}\ge1+\sum_{n\ge2}\frac{\beta_n}{(n+1)^2}\left(1+\frac{\beta_n}{n^2-1}\right)|L_n|^2-C S^{3/2}\sqrt{\log(e/S)}.

Finally @def-turn-measure gives $L_n=2\widehat\mu(n)/n$, which is the claimed inequality.

::: {#lem-toeplitz-positive-atoms .lemma name="Positive-atom Toeplitz bound" date="2026-10-31"}
Let $\mu$ be a finite real atomic measure of total mass $1$ with exactly $p$ positive atoms, allowing arbitrary negative atoms. For $0<\tau<1$,
$$
\sum_{n\ge1}\tau^n|\widehat\mu(n)|^2\ge\frac{\tau^p}{1-\tau^p}.
$$
:::

::: {.proof of="lem-toeplitz-positive-atoms"}
Define on $\ell^2(\mathbb N_0)$ the self-adjoint matrix
$$
A_{rs}=\tau^{(r+s)/2}\widehat\mu(r-s)=\sum_iw_i(v_i)_r\overline{(v_i)_s},
\qquad (v_i)_r=\tau^{r/2}e^{-ir\theta_i}.
$$
The Vandermonde vectors at distinct nodes are linearly independent, so $A$ has exactly $p$ positive eigenvalues $\alpha_1\ge\cdots\ge\alpha_p>0$. The trace is $(1-\tau)^{-1}$, and the negative eigenvalues can only decrease the trace, hence $Q:=\sum_i\alpha_i\ge(1-\tau)^{-1}$. The shift compression and the min--max principle give $\alpha_{i+1}\le\tau\alpha_i$. For fixed $Q$ and these ratio constraints, a finite exchange argument (move mass from an earlier coordinate to the latest coordinate until the active constraint is met) shows that the minimum of the strictly convex function $\sum_i\alpha_i^2$ is attained at
$$
\alpha_i=Q\frac{(1-\tau)\tau^{i-1}}{1-\tau^p},\qquad 1\le i\le p.
$$
Consequently
$$
\sum_i\alpha_i^2\ge Q^2\frac{1-\tau}{1+\tau}\frac{1+\tau^p}{1-\tau^p}
\ge\frac{1+\tau^p}{(1-\tau^2)(1-\tau^p)}.
$$
On the other hand,
$$
\|A\|_{HS}^2=\frac{1+2\sum_{n\ge1}\tau^n|\widehat\mu(n)|^2}{1-\tau^2}
$$
and the Hilbert--Schmidt norm dominates the squared positive eigenvalues. Rearranging gives
$$
1+2\sum_{n\ge1}\tau^n|\widehat\mu(n)|^2\ge\frac{1+\tau^p}{1-\tau^p},
$$
which is exactly the claimed bound.
:::

::: {#lem-kernel-comparison .lemma name="Positive kernel comparison" date="2026-10-31"}
For every $n\ge2$, the coefficients in @lem-spectral-core satisfy
$$
0<b_n\le a_n.
$$
Moreover,
$$
b_n=\int_0^\infty e^{-nt}\frac{1-\cos(\sqrt\kappa t)}\kappa\,dt,
$$
so for any signed atomic measure of total mass $1$ with $p$ positive atoms,
$$
E_b(\mu)\ge B_p.
$$
:::

::: {.proof of="lem-kernel-comparison"}
The Bessel bounds $5.78<j^2<5.8$ give $1.89<\kappa<1.9$. The recurrence for $J_n$ implies $0<\rho_n<2$ and, for $n\ge3$, $\rho_n<n\alpha/(n^2+\kappa)$ with $\alpha=\kappa+1$. Substitution into
$$
a_n=\frac{n-\rho_n+\rho_n^2/(n+1)^2}{n^2(n^2-1)}
$$
proves $a_n\ge b_n$; for $n=2$, the identity $J_0(j)=0$ reduces the inequality to $\kappa^3+7\kappa^2+12\kappa-54\ge0$, which holds for $\kappa\ge1.89$.

The Laplace representation follows from
$$
\int_0^\infty e^{-nt}(1-\cos(\sqrt\kappa t))\,dt=\frac{\kappa}{n(n^2+\kappa)}.
$$
Apply @lem-toeplitz-positive-atoms with $\tau=e^{-t}$ and integrate against the nonnegative weight $(1-\cos(\sqrt\kappa t))/\kappa$. Tonelli's theorem gives $E_b(\mu)\ge B_p$.
:::

::: {#lem-signed-turn-lower-bound .lemma name="Signed-turn spectral lower bound" date="2026-10-31"}
For a stationary polygon in the regime of @lem-spectral-core, if $p$ is its number of convex corners, then
$$
\frac{J(P)}{\pi j^2}\ge1+4B_p-C S^{3/2}\sqrt{\log(e/S)}.
$$
:::

::: {.proof of="lem-signed-turn-lower-bound"}
By @lem-spectral-core and @lem-kernel-comparison, $a_n\ge b_n$ for $n\ge2$. The missing $n=1$ term is harmless because @def-turn-measure gives $\widehat\mu(1)=0$. Hence
$$
\frac{J(P)}{\pi j^2}\ge 1+4E_b(\mu)-C S^{3/2}\sqrt{\log(e/S)}.
$$
The lower bound $E_b(\mu)\ge B_p$ is exactly @lem-kernel-comparison.
:::

::: {#lem-two-reflex-exclusion .lemma name="At least two reflex corners are excluded" date="2026-10-31"}
There is $N_1$ such that no stationary admissible $N$-gon in the sense of @def-stationary-polygon, with at least two reflex corners and with $J$ as in @def-j-functional, satisfies
$$
J(P)\le J(R_{N-1})
$$
for $N\ge N_1$.

::: {.proof .draft of="lem-two-reflex-exclusion"}
If there are at least two reflex corners, the number $p$ of convex corners is at most $N-2$. By @lem-near-circle-conformal, $S\le CN^{-3}$, and @lem-signed-turn-lower-bound gives

\frac{J(P)}{\pi j^2}\ge1+4B_{N-2}-o(N^{-4}).
$$
The estimate $B_p\ge\zeta(3)p^{-3}-\kappa\zeta(5)p^{-5}$ and the regular-polygon asymptotic in @lem-near-circle-conformal imply
$$
4B_{N-2}-\frac{4\zeta(3)}{(N-1)^3}=12\zeta(3)N^{-4}+O(N^{-5})>0
$$
for large $N$, so the assumed upper bound is impossible.
:::

::: {#lem-single-reflex-small-atom .lemma name="Single-reflex small positive atom" date="2026-10-31"}
There is a universal $C$ such that a stationary admissible $N$-gon satisfying the edge moments of @lem-edge-moments, with exactly one reflex corner and in the regime of @lem-near-circle-conformal, has an adjacent convex corner $i$ whose turn weight $a=w_i>0$ in @def-turn-measure satisfies
$$
a\le C N^{-9/4}\sqrt{\log N}.
$$
:::

::: {.proof .draft of="lem-single-reflex-small-atom"}
The boundary identity in @def-conformal-data gives a homogeneous $H^{1/2}$ seminorm of $F-F(0)-z$ equal to $S$; restricting it to a straight prevertex arc of length $\varepsilon$ gives a lower bound $c\varepsilon^4$, hence every prevertex gap is at most $CS^{1/4}$. The boundary derivative estimate accompanying @lem-disk-perturbation gives for the disk boundary derivative $p=-\partial_rv$ on every such arc
$$
\operatorname{osc}_I p\le C\{\sqrt S\,\varepsilon\sqrt{\log(e/\varepsilon)}+S\}\le CS^{3/4}\sqrt{\log(e/S)}.
$$

Place the unique negative turn at angle $0$. The cotangent formula for $\ell=\log|F'|$ shows that, on one of the adjacent edges selected according to the sign of the constant term, $|F'|$ is monotone and the logarithmic drop across a central subarc is at least $c(a+v)$, where $-v$ is the reflex weight and $a$ is the selected adjacent positive weight. For the decreasing function $h=|F'|$, define
$$
\mathsf A=\int_{s<t}h(s)/h(t)\,dsdt,\qquad
\mathsf B=\int_{s<t}h(t)/h(s)\,dsdt.
$$
A four-rectangle comparison gives
$$
\frac{\mathsf A-\mathsf B}{\mathsf A+\mathsf B}\ge c(a+v).
$$
Put $k_0=h^{-2}$ and normalize the selected edge to $x\in[0,1]$. The identity equating $D$ with a first moment of $k_0$ is not valid for a general monotone $h$; the needed valid substitute is the following elementary one-dimensional estimate:
$$
D=\frac{\int_{s<t}(h(s)/h(t)-h(t)/h(s))\,dsdt}{\int_{s<t}(h(s)/h(t)+h(t)/h(s))\,dsdt},\quad
\int_0^1(x-1/2)p(x)^2k_0(x)\,dx=0
\Longrightarrow
D\le C\frac{\max_Ip-\min_Ip}{\min_Ip}.
$$
To verify it, write the numerator and denominator with $k_0=h^{-2}$, split the square into the four rectangles determined by $x=1/2$, and use monotonicity of $k_0$; the centered-moment equation replaces every occurrence of $\int(x-1/2)k_0$ by $-\int(x-1/2)(p^2-p_*^2)k_0$, while the denominator is bounded below by the same positive rectangle integrals. Since $p\ge p_D/2$ uniformly, this gives $D\le C\operatorname{osc}_I p$. The lower bound $D\ge c(a+v)$ and the last inequality imply $a+v\le C S^{3/4}\sqrt{\log(e/S)}$. Combining this with $S\le CN^{-3}$ proves the stated bound.
:::

::: {#lem-atom-deletion .lemma name="Deletion preserves the comparison energy" date="2026-10-31"}
Let $P$ be a stationary admissible $N$-gon in the one-reflex regime satisfying $J(P)\le J(R_{N-1})$, with $J,R$ as in @def-j-functional and $\mu$ the one-reflex measure in @def-turn-measure. Let $p=N-1$, and let $a$ be the small positive atom from @lem-single-reflex-small-atom. Put
$$
\widetilde\mu=\frac{\mu-a\delta_{\theta_*}}{1-a}.
$$
Then $\widetilde\mu$ has total mass $1$ and $N-2$ positive atoms, and
$$
E_b(\widetilde\mu)-E_b(\mu)=o(N^{-4}).
$$
:::

::: {.proof .draft of="lem-atom-deletion"}
Let $\delta=E_b(\mu)-B_{N-1}\ge0$. By @lem-signed-turn-lower-bound, the assumed upper bound and the regular-polygon asymptotic imply
$$
\delta\le CN^{-9/2}\sqrt{\log N}.
$$
For $U_b(\theta)=\sum_{n\ge1}b_n\operatorname{Re}(\widehat\mu(n)e^{in\theta})$, the Laplace representation in @def-positive-kernel and Cauchy--Schwarz give
$$
\|U_b\|_\infty\le C\sqrt\delta+CN^{-5/2}.
$$
The exact expansion is
$$
E_b(\widetilde\mu)-E_b(\mu)=
\frac{2a(E_b(\mu)-U_b(\theta_*))+a^2(K_b(0)-E_b(\mu))}{(1-a)^2},
$$
where $K_b(0)=\sum_{n\ge1}b_n$. Since @lem-single-reflex-small-atom gives $a=O(N^{-9/4}\sqrt{\log N})$ and $E_b(\mu)=O(N^{-3})$, the right side is $O(N^{-9/2}\log N)=o(N^{-4})$.
:::

::: {#thm-main-large-n-convexity .theorem .goal name="Large-N low-threshold stationary polygons are convex" date="2026-10-31"}
There is a universal $N_0$ such that, for every $N\ge N_0$, every admissible stationary simple $N$-gon $P$ satisfying
$$
J(P)\le J(R_{N-1})
$$
 is convex. Consequently, no such polygon satisfies $J(P)<m_{N-1}$ while being non-convex.
:::

::: {.proof .draft of="thm-main-large-n-convexity"}
Assume the conclusion fails. If there are at least two reflex corners, @lem-two-reflex-exclusion gives a contradiction. Thus there is exactly one reflex corner. Apply @lem-single-reflex-small-atom and @lem-atom-deletion. The deleted measure has $N-2$ positive atoms, and @lem-kernel-comparison yields $E_b(\widetilde\mu)\ge B_{N-2}$. By the proof of @lem-signed-turn-lower-bound (equivalently, by @lem-spectral-core together with @lem-kernel-comparison),
$$
\frac{J(P)}{\pi j^2}\ge1+4E_b(\mu)-C S^{3/2}\sqrt{\log(e/S)}.
$$
Using @lem-atom-deletion and $S\le CN^{-3}$ from @lem-near-circle-conformal gives
$$
\frac{J(P)}{\pi j^2}\ge1+4B_{N-2}-o(N^{-4}).
$$
The regular-polygon asymptotic gives
$$
\frac{J(R_{N-1})}{\pi j^2}=1+\frac{4\zeta(3)}{(N-1)^3}+O(N^{-5}),
$$
while $B_{N-2}=\zeta(3)(N-2)^{-3}+O(N^{-5})$. Their difference is $12\zeta(3)N^{-4}+O(N^{-5})$, contradicting $J(P)\le J(R_{N-1})$ for large $N$.
:::

## 5. 核心统一非线性谱下界的详细推导

本节把实际谱展开中的 g=f−1 转换为 L=logf 的正二次型。困难在于：小 Bergman 范数并不给出 f 或 f⁻¹ 的一致点值小量，不能直接把 k=f⁻¹−1 当成 −g 加上普通 A² 意义下的二阶小量。正确做法是先独立展开 (g,k)，再只在具有额外频率衰减的项中使用逆关系。

**原文状态。** 原对话给出了下列替换、径向乘子、梯度像面积的计算路线，但没有写出全部估计。本节补写这些计算；所用谱分支及角点恒等式分别以第 3 节和第 2 节为输入。它们的技术适用性在第 11 节单列，不能由本节倒推。

### 5.1 带频率衰减的替换引理

所有 Aᵖ 范数均用归一化面积测度 dA/π。记

\[
\mathcal E(S)=S^{3/2}\sqrt{\log(e/S)},\qquad 0<S<s_0<1.
\tag{5.3}
\]

先证明一个通用分频估计。若解析函数 D(z)=Σₙ≥₂Dₙzⁿ 满足

\[
\|D\|_{A^1}\le C_1S,\qquad
\|D\|_{A^2}^2\le C_2S,
\tag{5.A1}
\]

则系数面积积分公式给出

\[
D_n=\frac{n+1}{\pi}\int_D D(z)\overline z^{\,n}dA(z),
\qquad |D_n|\le C_1(n+1)S.
\]

取 K=⌈S⁻¹ᐟ²⌉。低频部分和高频部分分别满足

\[
\begin{aligned}
\sum_{2\le n\le K}\frac{|D_n|^2}{(n+1)^3}
&\le C_1^2S^2\sum_{2\le n\le K}\frac1{n+1}
\le CS^2\log(e/S),\\
\sum_{n>K}\frac{|D_n|^2}{(n+1)^3}
&\le (K+1)^{-2}\sum_{n>K}\frac{|D_n|^2}{n+1}
\le CS^2.
\end{aligned}
\tag{5.A2}
\]

对 D₁=g+k=−gk，由 T≤CS 及 Hölder 不等式，

\[
\|D_1\|_{A^1}\le\|g\|_{A^2}\|k\|_{A^2}\le CS,
\qquad
\|D_1\|_{A^2}^2\le2(S+T)\le CS.
\]

这里第二个界使用 D₁=g+k，而不是把乘积 gk 直接当成有界 A² 乘法。因此

\[
\boxed{\sum_{n\ge2}\frac{|g_n+k_n|^2}{(n+1)^3}
\le CS^2\log(e/S).}
\tag{5.1}
\]

若实乘子满足 |bₙ|≤C_b/(n+1)²，则利用精确代数式

\[
|k_n|^2-|g_n|^2
=\operatorname{Re}\{(k_n+g_n)\overline{(k_n-g_n)}\}
\]

及 Cauchy–Schwarz，得到

\[
\begin{aligned}
\left|\sum_{n\ge2}b_n(|k_n|^2-|g_n|^2)\right|
&\le C_b
\left(\sum\frac{|k_n+g_n|^2}{(n+1)^3}\right)^{1/2}
\left(\sum\frac{|k_n-g_n|^2}{n+1}\right)^{1/2}\\
&\le C\mathcal E(S).
\end{aligned}
\tag{5.2}
\]

对混合项也有同样结论：如果 |mₙ|≤C/(n+1)²，那么

\[
\left|\sum m_n\operatorname{Re}\{g_n\overline{(k_n+g_n)}\}\right|
\le C\mathcal E(S).
\tag{5.A3}
\]

再处理 D₂=L−g。对任意复数 z 都有

\[
|e^z-1-z|\le C\bigl(|e^z-1|^2+|z|^2\bigr).
\tag{5.A4}
\]

证明只需分成 |z|≤1 的 Taylor 余项及 |z|>1 的三角不等式：后者用 |eᶻ−1|+|z|≤C(|eᶻ−1|²+|z|²)。代入 z=L，并使用式 (4.5)，可得 ∥L−g∥A¹≤CS、∥L−g∥A²²≤CS。故同一分频论证给出

\[
\left|\sum b_n(|g_n|^2-|L_n|^2)\right|
\le C\mathcal E(S)
\quad\text{当 }|b_n|\le C_b(n+1)^{-2}.
\tag{5.A5}
\]

以上常数只依赖固定的范数界和乘子常数，不涉及多边形的节点配置。

### 5.2 双变量泛函及其三阶余项

令 v(g)、λ(g) 为第 3 节中在固定圆盘上构造、并满足 ∫v²|1+g|²=1 的正谱分支。定义

\[
\mathscr H(g,k)=
\int_D|\nabla v(g)|^4|1+k|^2
-\lambda(g)^2\int_Dv(g)^4|1+g|^2
+\frac{\lambda(g)^2}{\pi(1+\|g\|_{A^2}^2)}.
\tag{5.4}
\]

暂将 g、k 视为 A² 中两个独立的解析变量，且它们的常数项、一次项均为零。v(g) 在 X=C¹(D̄)∩{零边界值} 中实解析。积分中的因子 |k|²、|g|² 属于 L¹；例如

\[
\left|\int_D a(x)k_1\overline{k_2}\,dA\right|
\le\pi\|a\|_\infty\|k_1\|_{A^2}\|k_2\|_{A^2}.
\]

这说明 H 的各项都是有界多线性映射与解析映射的复合。因此存在固定半径及固定常数，使

\[
\mathscr H(g,k)=H_2(g,k)+R_H(g,k),\qquad
|R_H(g,k)|\le C(\|g\|_{A^2}+\|k\|_{A^2})^3.
\tag{5.A6}
\]

零阶项为零，是因为圆盘满足式 (2.4)；一次项为零，是因为 v₀ 径向，v₁、Re g、Re k 的每个圆周平均均为零，且 λ₁=0。在实际驻点处，式 (4.2) 给 H(g,k)=0，而 T≤CS 将余项统一控制为 O(S³ᐟ²)。此处没有展开映射 g↦(1+g)⁻¹。

为列全二次项，写 λ=j²+λ₂+O(∥g∥³)、v=v₀+v₁+v₂+O_X(∥g∥³)，下标表示齐次阶，不包含额外的阶乘。记

\[
\begin{aligned}
a(r)&=v_0'(r)^4,\qquad p_D=-v_0'(1),\\
b_1(g)&=4|\nabla v_0|^2\nabla v_0\cdot\nabla v_1,\\
a_2(g)&=4|\nabla v_0|^2\nabla v_0\cdot\nabla v_2
+2|\nabla v_0|^2|\nabla v_1|^2
+4(\nabla v_0\cdot\nabla v_1)^2,\\
c_2(g)&=4v_0^3v_2+6v_0^2v_1^2
+8v_0^3v_1\operatorname{Re}g+v_0^4|g|^2.
\end{aligned}
\tag{5.A7}
\]

直接逐项相乘得到

\[
\begin{aligned}
H_2(g,k)&=\pi p_D^4(T-S)+Q_0(g)+A(k)+M(g,k),\\
Q_0(g)&=\int_Da_2-j^4\int_Dc_2
+2j^2\lambda_2\left(\pi^{-1}-\int_Dv_0^4\right),\\
A(k)&=\int_D(a(r)-p_D^4)|k|^2,\\
M(g,k)&=2\int_Db_1(g)\operatorname{Re}k.
\end{aligned}
\tag{5.A8}
\]

其中 πp_D⁴=j⁴/π，负的 S 项恰好来自最后一项中 (1+S)⁻¹=1−S+O(S²)。这列出了全部二次项，未将任何未知的纯 g 项藏入误差。下面通过梯度像面积算出 Q₀(g)+A(−g)+M(g,−g)。

### 5.3 两个径向乘子的明确估计

径向正交性给出

\[
A(k)=\sum_{n\ge2}A_n|k_n|^2,
\quad A_n=2\pi\int_0^1(v_0'(r)^4-p_D^4)r^{2n+1}dr.
\tag{5.A9}
\]

v₀ 是固定圆盘上的光滑函数，且 a(1)=p_D⁴，故 |a(r)−p_D⁴|≤C(1−r)。于是

\[
|A_n|\le2\pi C\int_0^1(1-r)r^{2n+1}dr
=\frac{2\pi C}{(2n+2)(2n+3)}.
\tag{5.A10}
\]

这就是第一个 O(n⁻²) 乘子。第二个乘子需要保留一阶响应内部的抵消。写

\[
v_1(g)=\sum_{n\ge2}w_n(r)\operatorname{Re}(g_ne^{in\theta}),
\quad
w_n(r)=\frac{r^{n+1}v_0'(r)+p_DJ_n(jr)/J_n(j)}{n+1}.
\tag{5.A11}
\]

利用 ∫₀²πRe(αeⁱⁿθ)Re(βeⁱᵐθ)dθ=πδₙₘRe(αβ̄)，有

\[
M(g,k)=\sum_{n\ge2}M_n\operatorname{Re}(g_n\overline{k_n}),
\quad M_n=8\pi\int_0^1v_0'(r)^3w_n'(r)r^{n+1}dr.
\tag{5.A12}
\]

下面证明 |Mₙ|≤C/(n+1)³，而不是直接宣称由 Bessel 公式可知。设 σ=j²/4，并令

\[
H_n(s)=\sum_{m\ge0}\frac{(-\sigma s)^m n!}{m!(n+m)!},
\quad
B_n(r)=\frac{H_n(r^2)}{H_n(1)}
=\frac{J_n(jr)}{r^nJ_n(j)}.
\tag{5.A13}
\]

n≥2 时，交错级数给 Hₙ(1)≥1−σ/(n+1)>1/2；逐项绝对估计给 sup₀≤s≤₁|Hₙ′(s)|≤C/(n+1)。所以

\[
|B_n(r)-1|\le\frac{C(1-r)}{n+1},\qquad
|B_n'(r)|\le\frac C{n+1}.
\tag{5.A14}
\]

再设 A₀(r)=rv₀′(r)/p_D。圆盘径向方程 v₀″+r⁻¹v₀′+j²v₀=0 及 v₀(1)=0 给出

\[
A_0(1)=-1,\qquad A_0'(1)=0,
\quad |A_0(r)+1|\le C(1-r)^2,
\quad |A_0'(r)|\le C(1-r).
\tag{5.A15}
\]

因此 wₙ=p_Drⁿ(A₀+Bₙ)/(n+1)，微分后得到统一的边界层界

\[
|w_n'(r)|\le Cr^{n-1}
\left((1-r)^2+\frac{1-r}{n+1}+\frac1{(n+1)^2}\right).
\tag{5.A16}
\]

将其代入式 (5.A12)，再用

\[
\int_0^1r^m(1-r)^\ell dr
=\frac{\ell!}{(m+1)(m+2)\cdots(m+\ell+1)}
\quad(\ell=0,1,2),
\]

可得

\[
|M_n|\le C\int_0^1r^{2n}
\left((1-r)^2+\frac{1-r}{n+1}+\frac1{(n+1)^2}\right)dr
\le\frac C{(n+1)^3}.
\tag{5.A17}
\]

**关键抵消。** A₀(1)+Bₙ(1)=0 且 A₀′(1)=0，使边界层积分比未保留抵消的粗估计多衰减。以上全部常数来自固定 j、固定 v₀ 和 Bessel 级数界。

式 (5.2)、(5.A3) 现在可实际应用于

\[
A(k)+M(g,k)=A(-g)+M(g,-g)+O(\mathcal E(S)).
\tag{5.5}
\]

πp_D⁴T 的乘子只有 πp_D⁴/(n+1)，不满足上述替换条件，必须保留原样。

### 5.4 用梯度像面积计算剩余完整二次型

先固定一个多项式方向 g=azⁿ，n≥2。对足够小实 t，Fₜ′=1+tazⁿ 给出圆盘的光滑单叶变形。因为方向固定且有界，可令 Re Fₜ′>0；沿圆盘内线段积分即可验证单叶性。此处只要求每个固定方向存在自己的小 t 区间，并不要求单叶性半径在 A² 单位球上一致。

令 k(t)=(1+tg)⁻¹−1=−tg+O(t²)。H 的一次项为零，因此

\[
\mathscr H(tg,k(t))=t^2H_2(g,-g)+O_g(t^3).
\tag{5.A18}
\]

下标 g 表示这一步的路径误差可以依赖固定多项式；最后统一余项将使用式 (5.A6)，不使用这一路径误差。

设 pₜ=−∂ᵣvₜ。在 r=1 上，Bessel 递推给

\[
w_n'(1)=-\frac{p_D\rho_n}{n+1},\qquad
\dot p=\frac{p_D\rho_n}{n+1}\operatorname{Re}(ae^{in\theta}).
\tag{5.A19}
\]

物理通量 qₜ=pₜ²/|Fₜ′|²，而 λ̇=0、Ȧ=0，所以 ċ=0。故

\[
\dot q-\dot c=-\frac{2p_D^2\beta_n}{n+1}
\operatorname{Re}(ae^{in\theta}),
\quad \beta_n=n+1-\rho_n.
\tag{5.6}
\]

对每个光滑变形域，取其校准 Airy 势 Φₜ，并记边界梯度像 Γₜ(θ)=∇Φₜ(Fₜ(eⁱθ))，将向量等同于复数。沿边界有

\[
\frac{d\Gamma_t}{d\theta}
=\frac12(q_t-c_t)\,i e^{i\theta}F_t'(e^{i\theta}).
\tag{5.A20}
\]

圆盘上 q₀=c₀=p_D²，故可平移梯度像使 Γ₀=0。先取 a 为实数，并记 d=−2p_D²βₙa/(n+1)。对式 (5.A20) 微分、再积分，有

\[
\dot\Gamma'(\theta)=\frac d2\cos(n\theta)i e^{i\theta},
\qquad
\dot\Gamma(\theta)=\frac d4
\left(\frac{e^{i(n+1)\theta}}{n+1}
+\frac{e^{i(1-n)\theta}}{1-n}\right)
\tag{5.A21}
\]

至多相差一个不影响有向面积的常向量。复曲线 Γ=Σcₖeⁱᵏθ 的有向面积为 πΣk|cₖ|²，所以

\[
\operatorname{Area}_{\rm signed}(\dot\Gamma)
=\frac{\pi d^2}{16}
\left(\frac1{n+1}+\frac1{1-n}\right)
=-\frac{\pi d^2}{8(n^2-1)}.
\tag{5.A22}
\]

另一方面，对任一此类光滑域，直接计算 Hessian 行列式并使用 ∫u²=1，得到

\[
\mathscr H=-4\int_P\det D^2\Phi
=-4\operatorname{Area}_{\rm signed}(\nabla\Phi|_{\partial P}).
\tag{5.A23}
\]

第二个等号是 Stokes 公式；它计算带方向和重数的面积，不要求梯度像曲线简单或梯度映射单叶。因 Γ₀=0，面积的 t² 系数正是式 (5.A22)。故

\[
H_2(az^n,-az^n)
=2\pi p_D^4
\frac{\beta_n^2}{(n+1)^2(n^2-1)}|a|^2.
\tag{5.7}
\]

复 a 的情况由旋转得到。泛函旋转不变，因此其限制 H₂(g,−g) 的实二次型只有 |gₙ|² 项：交叉项 gₙḡₘ 在旋转下有频率 n−m，gₙgₘ 有频率 n+m，除 n=m 的第一类外均不能留下。于是对任意解析多项式

\[
H_2(g,-g)=2\pi p_D^4\sum_{n\ge2}
\frac{\beta_n^2}{(n+1)^2(n^2-1)}|g_n|^2.
\tag{5.A24}
\]

现在说明推广过程。由 0<ρₙ<2，有 0<βₙ<n+1，所以式 (5.A24) 的乘子至多 C/(n+1)²，定义 A² 上连续二次型；左端作为解析泛函的二阶项同样连续。解析多项式在 A² 中稠密，故两者在全部 A² 数据上相等。推广不需要多边形预顶点分离，也不需要逼近多项式的逆导数具有统一范数。

### 5.5 回到真实逆关系并提取 S−T

在真实驻点处，H(g,k)=0。由式 (5.A6)、(5.A8)、(5.5)、(5.A24)，

\[
0=\pi p_D^4(T-S)
+2\pi p_D^4\sum_{n\ge2}
\frac{\beta_n^2}{(n+1)^2(n^2-1)}|g_n|^2
+O(\mathcal E(S)).
\]

除以固定正数 πp_D⁴，得到

\[
\boxed{S-T=2\sum_{n\ge2}
\frac{\beta_n^2}{(n+1)^2(n^2-1)}|g_n|^2
+O(\mathcal E(S)).}
\tag{5.8}
\]

这里统一常数来自三个可追踪的界：固定圆盘谱分支的三阶余项、T≤CS、式 (5.A10) 和 (5.A17) 的乘子估计。不是由光滑单叶路径的 t 区间取得。

### 5.6 得到对数转角的正二次型

令 dₙ=βₙ²/[(n+1)²(n²−1)]，rₙ=ρₙ/(n+1)²。式 (4.5) 给 S≥∥L∥A²²+(S−T)/2。代入实际谱展开式 (3.9)，得到

\[
\mathcal J(P)\ge1+\|L\|_{A^2}^2
+\sum_{n\ge2}(d_n-r_n)|g_n|^2-C\mathcal E(S).
\tag{5.A25}
\]

dₙ=O(n⁻²)，rₙ=O(n⁻³)，故式 (5.A5) 可将最后的 g 换成 L。注意被替换的只有 dₙ−rₙ，未替换主范数的 O(n⁻¹) 乘子。整理系数即得

\[
\boxed{\mathcal J(P)\ge
1+\sum_{n\ge2}\gamma_n|L_n|^2-C\mathcal E(S),}
\tag{5.9}
\]

\[
\gamma_n=\frac1{n+1}-\frac{\rho_n}{(n+1)^2}

::: {#lem-c1-perturbation .lemma name="Uniform C1 conformal perturbation" date="2026-11-02"}
Let
$$
X=\{\phi\in C^1(\overline{\mathbb D};\mathbb R):\phi|_{\partial\mathbb D}=0\},
\qquad \|\phi\|_X=\|\nabla\phi\|_{L^\infty}.
$$
For normalized conformal data from @def-conformal-data with $S=\|g\|_{A^2}^2$ sufficiently small, writing $g=t h$ with $t=\sqrt S$ and $\|h\|_{A^2}=1$, the pulled-back first eigenfunction has a uniform real-analytic expansion
$$
v=v_0+t v_1+v^{(2)}+R,
\qquad \|v_1\|_X\le C,
\qquad \|v^{(2)}\|_X\le CS,
\qquad \|R\|_X\le CS^{3/2},
$$
where $v_0(r)=J_0(jr)/(\sqrt\pi J_1(j))$, $v_1$ has no radial Fourier mode, and the corresponding eigenvalue branch is the positive first branch. More precisely, with $g=th$,
$$
(-\Delta-j^2)v_1=2j^2\operatorname{Re}(h)v_0\quad\text{in }\mathbb D,
\qquad v_1|_{\partial\mathbb D}=0.
$$
If $h(z)=\sum_{n\ge2}h_nz^n$, then
$$
v_1(r,\theta)=\sum_{n\ge2}w_n(r)\operatorname{Re}(h_ne^{in\theta}),
\quad
w_n(r)=\frac{r^{n+1}v_0'(r)+p_DJ_n(jr)/J_n(j)}{n+1},
$$
where $p_D=j/\sqrt\pi$ and $w_n'(1)=-p_D\rho_n/(n+1)$ with $\rho_n=jJ_{n+1}(j)/J_n(j)$.
:::

::: {.proof of="lem-c1-perturbation" status="rejected"}
By @def-conformal-data, $g$ is analytic, has no constant or linear coefficient, and satisfies $S=\|g\|_{A^2}^2$; its normalized conformal pullback is the weighted disk problem used below. Put $d(z)=1-|z|$. The Green kernel of the disk satisfies
$$
|\nabla_xG_D(x,z)|\le C|x-z|^{-1},
\qquad
|\nabla_xG_D(x,z)|\le C\frac{d(z)}{|x-z|^2}.
$$
The Bergman pointwise estimate gives $|g(z)|\le C\|g\|_{A^2}/d(z)$ for $g\in A^2$ with vanishing constant coefficient. If $h\in X$, then $|h(z)|\le d(z)\|h\|_X$. Splitting the Green integral into $|x-z|<d(x)/2$, the annulus $d(x)/2\le|x-z|<2d(x)$, and dyadic outer annuli, the two kernel bounds give
$$
\|G_D(gh)\|_X\le C\|g\|_{A^2}\|h\|_X,
\qquad
\|G_D(g_1\overline{g_2}h)\|_X\le C\|g_1\|_{A^2}\|g_2\|_{A^2}\|h\|_X.
$$
For example, in the near region $d(z)\simeq d(x)$ and the pointwise bounds leave an integrable $|x-z|^{-1}$ kernel; in the outer annuli $d(z)\le d(x)+|x-z|$ cancels one power of the second Green bound, and Cauchy--Schwarz gives $\|g_1g_2\|_{L^1}\le C\|g_1\|_{A^2}\|g_2\|_{A^2}$. Polynomial approximation extends these estimates to all $A^2$ data, and the Green potential has a continuous boundary derivative.

Define the real quadratic compact-operator family
$$
K_g h=G_D[|1+g|^2h]=G_D[h+2\operatorname{Re}(g)h+|g|^2h]
$$
onlinearly in $g$. The estimates give $\|K_g-K_0\|_{B(X)}\le C(\sqrt S+S)$. The operator $K_0$ is compact on $X$ by disk Poisson regularity and the compact embedding $C^{2,\alpha}(\overline{\mathbb D})\Subset C^1(\overline{\mathbb D})$. Its nonzero eigenvalues are the reciprocals of the Dirichlet eigenvalues; $1/j^2$ is an isolated simple eigenvalue.

Choose a fixed small contour $\Gamma$ enclosing only $1/j^2$. For $S$ small, the Neumann series uniformly bounds $(zI-K_g)^{-1}$ on $\Gamma$ and defines the rank-one Riesz projection
$$
\Pi_g=\frac1{2\pi i}\int_\Gamma(zI-K_g)^{-1}\,dz.
$$
The normalized vector
$$
\widetilde v(g)=\Pi_gv_0,
\qquad
v(g)=\frac{\widetilde v(g)}{\left(\int_{\mathbb D}\widetilde v(g)^2|1+g|^2\right)^{1/2}}
$$
therefore depends real-analytically on $g$ in a fixed $A^2$ neighborhood; the denominator stays uniformly away from zero. Writing $g=t h$, define $v_1=Dv(0)[h]$; its forcing has no radial Fourier mode because $h$ has no constant coefficient. The remaining Taylor terms give $v^{(2)}+R$, and Cauchy estimates on this fixed neighborhood give the displayed bounds with constants independent of the direction of $g$.

The form identity
$$
\int_{\mathbb D}|g|^2|\phi|^2\,dA
\le C\|g\|_{A^2}^2\int_{\mathbb D}|\nabla\phi|^2\,dA,
\qquad \phi\in H^1_0(\mathbb D),
$$
which follows from Hardy's inequality, shows that the pulled-back eigenfunction belongs to the weighted Dirichlet space and that the branch is the first Dirichlet branch. Since $v_0\ge c,d$ and $\|v-v_0\|_X\le C\sqrt S$, the branch is strictly positive in $\mathbb D$. This proves the lemma.

::: {.proof of="lem-near-circle-conformal" status="verified"}
Use the similarity invariance in @def-j-functional to normalize $A(P)=\pi$ and translate so that the Fraenkel-optimal comparison disk is $D=B_1(0)$. The regular-polygon asymptotic is
$$
\frac{J(R_M)}{\pi j^2}=1+\frac{4\zeta(3)}{M^3}+O(M^{-5}).
$$
The upper bound and the displayed asymptotic give $\lambda_1(P)\le j^2(1+CN^{-3})$, while Faber--Krahn gives $\lambda_1(P)\ge j^2$. Quantitative Faber--Krahn therefore gives $|P\triangle D|\to0$. Let $u_N$ be the normalized positive eigenfunction and extend it by zero. By @lem-uniform-w14, the extensions are uniformly bounded in $W^{1,4}(\mathbb R^2)$ and hence equicontinuous and uniformly bounded. Arzelà--Ascoli gives a locally uniform limit along a subsequence. On every compact set outside $\overline D$, the limit must vanish: otherwise the uniform Hölder bound would force a fixed positive amount of area in $P_N\setminus D$, contradicting $|P_N\triangle D|\to0$. The same argument gives zero trace on $\partial D$. Since $\|u_N\|_\infty$ is uniformly bounded, the mass outside $D$ tends to zero; hence the limit has $L^2(D)$ norm one. Weak lower semicontinuity gives $\int_D|\nabla u|^2\le\liminf\lambda_1(P_N)=j^2$, while the disk Rayleigh inequality gives the reverse inequality. Thus the limit is the normalized positive disk eigenfunction $u_0$. Uniqueness of the limit upgrades the whole sequence to local uniform convergence, and the boundary Hölder bound upgrades it to uniform convergence on $\overline D$. Since $u_0>0$ on $B_{1-\eta}$, eventually $u_N>0$ there; because the zero extension vanishes off $P_N$, $B_{1-\eta}\subset P_N$.

The maximal conformal radius is at least $1-\eta$ by monotonicity under inclusion and at most $1$ by the conformal area inequality $A(P)\ge\pi r_P^2$. In the normalization of @def-conformal-data, $1+S=r_P^{-2}\to1$.

By @lem-disk-perturbation, once $N$ is large enough that $S\le S_0$, the uniform expansion and coercivity give
$$
\frac{J(P)}{\pi j^2}-1\ge S/6.
$$
The regular-polygon upper bound is $O(N^{-3})$, hence $S\le CN^{-3}$ with a universal constant.

For the normalized conformal data in @def-conformal-data in the regime of @lem-disk-perturbation, let $v$ be the positive weighted first eigenfunction and let $v_0(r)=J_0(jr)/(\sqrt\pi J_1(j))$. \|v-v_0-t v_1\|_{W^{1,4}(\mathbb D)}\le CS,

Moreover, $\|b_1\|_{L^\infty(\mathbb D)}\le C$ and the remainder in this last display is bounded in $L^\infty(\mathbb D)$ by $CS$.

The constant is universal and independent of polygonal angles and vertex separation.

因此，在核心谱引理的一致性成立的前提下，普通简单多边形类中，充分大 N 的非凸驻点不可能满足 J(P)≤J(R_N)。普通的 N 边全局极小候选是驻点，并且可与 R_N 比较，所以它必凸。此处没有假设 R_N 已经在非凸类中最优。

## 8. 单反角附加引理的详细推导

第 7 节用 p≤N−1 排除阈值 J(R_N)。若参考值改为 J(R_{N−1})，唯一反角情形恰有 p=N−1，离散下界的首项与参考值相同。必须额外从真实驻点条件找到一个足够小的正原子，然后在第 9 节的离散能量中删除它。

**原文状态。** 原对话给出半范数、局部压力、cot 场和质心差的路线，但略去定量常数及换元。本节逐项补写。全节以第 3 节的 C¹ 谱展开为前提，不使用第 5 节的尖锐谱下界；因此它不能反过来修补第 5 节。

### 8.1 直边约束给出预顶点弧长上界

令 H(z)=F(z)−F(0)−z。由式 (3.2)，

\[
H(z)=\sum_{n\ge2}\frac{g_n}{n+1}z^{n+1}.
\]

定义圆周上的齐次半范数

\[
\mathcal Q(H)=\int_0^{2\pi}\int_0^{2\pi}
\frac{|H(e^{i\theta})-H(e^{i\varphi})|^2}
{|e^{i\theta}-e^{i\varphi}|^2}\,d\theta d\varphi.
\tag{8.A1}
\]

单个模式 eⁱᵏθ 的双积分等于 4π²|k|；由 Fourier 正交性及有限 Dirichlet 能量的逼近，精确得到

\[
\mathcal Q(H)=4\pi^2\sum_{n\ge2}\frac{|g_n|^2}{n+1}
=4\pi^2S.
\tag{8.A2}
\]

设 I 是某条实际边对应的预顶点弧，长度为 ε。取该直线单位法向 ν。因为 ν·F(eⁱθ) 在 I 上为常数，

\[
\nu\cdot H(e^{i\theta})=\text{常数}-\nu\cdot e^{i\theta}.
\tag{8.A3}
\]

将弧中点移至参数 t=0，并写 ν·eⁱ⁽θ₀₊ₜ⁾=A cos t+B sin t，A²+B²=1。先设 ε≤1，t,s∈[−ε/2,ε/2]。由于 |eⁱᵗ−eⁱˢ|≤|t−s|，把式 (8.A1) 限制到 I×I，再投影到 ν，得到下界

\[
\int_{-\varepsilon/2}^{\varepsilon/2}
\int_{-\varepsilon/2}^{\varepsilon/2}
\frac{|A(\cos t-\cos s)+B(\sin t-\sin s)|^2}{(t-s)^2}\,dt ds.
\tag{8.A4}
\]

同时令 (t,s)↦(−t,−s)，余弦差不变、正弦差变号，故积分中的混合项为零。又有

\[
\frac{\sin t-\sin s}{t-s}
=\cos\frac{t+s}2\,\operatorname{sinc}\frac{t-s}2,
\quad
\frac{\cos t-\cos s}{t-s}
=-\sin\frac{t+s}2\,\operatorname{sinc}\frac{t-s}2,
\]

其中 sinc x=sin x/x。在 ε≤1 的范围内，第一式绝对值有固定正下界，第二式平方至少为 c(t+s)²。因此式 (8.A4) 至少为

\[
cB^2\varepsilon^2+cA^2
\int_{-\varepsilon/2}^{\varepsilon/2}
\int_{-\varepsilon/2}^{\varepsilon/2}(t+s)^2dt ds
=cB^2\varepsilon^2+\frac c6A^2\varepsilon^4
\ge c'\varepsilon^4.
\tag{8.A5}
\]

若 ε>1，取弧内长度为 1 的子弧，同样得到 S≥c₀>0。因此 S 足够小时，每条预顶点弧均≤1，并由式 (8.A2)、(8.A5) 得到

\[
\boxed{\Delta:=\max_i|I_i|\le CS^{1/4}.}
\tag{8.1}
\]

这个结论是最大间距上界；它允许任意小的最小间距。

### 8.2 圆盘边界导数的局部振荡

记 p(θ)=−∂ᵣv(eⁱθ)。第 3 节在 X 中的二阶展开给

\[
p=p_D+p_1+R_p,\qquad \|R_p\|_\infty\le CS.
\tag{8.A6}
\]

由式 (5.A19)，一阶项的精确表示为

\[
p_1(\theta)=p_D\sum_{n\ge2}
\frac{\rho_n}{n+1}\operatorname{Re}(g_ne^{in\theta}).
\tag{8.A7}
\]

Bessel 交错级数给 ρₙ≤C/(n+1)。于是对 |t|≤ε≤1，系数 Cauchy–Schwarz 给

\[
\begin{aligned}
|p_1(\theta+t)-p_1(\theta)|
&\le C\sqrt S
\left(\sum_{n\ge2}
\frac{\min(n^2t^2,4)}{(n+1)^3}\right)^{1/2}\\
&\le C\sqrt S\,\varepsilon\sqrt{\log(e/\varepsilon)}.
\end{aligned}
\tag{8.A8}
\]

最后一步在 n≈1/|t| 处分频：低频为 Ct²Σₙ≤₁/|t|1/n，高频为 CΣₙ>₁/|t|n⁻³≤Ct²。因此

\[
\operatorname{osc}_Ip
\le C\left[\sqrt S\,\varepsilon\sqrt{\log(e/\varepsilon)}+S\right].
\tag{8.2}
\]

同样的 Cauchy–Schwarz（不取差分）给 ∥p₁∥∞≤C√S，故 S 小时 p≥p_D/2。结合 ε≤CS¹ᐟ⁴，得到每条边对应弧上的统一估计

\[
\boxed{\operatorname{osc}_Ip\le C\eta,
\qquad \eta=S^{3/4}\sqrt{\log(e/S)}.}
\tag{8.3}
\]

其中 S 项已被 η 吸收。这一步控制的是圆盘上的 p，物理通量还要除以 |f|；不能直接把 p 的振荡误认为物理 q 的振荡。

### 8.3 唯一负原子的 cot 场及选边

将唯一负原子旋转到 θ=0，权重记为 −b，0<b<1/2；其余权重为 aⱼ∈(0,1/2)，预顶点依次位于 (0,2π)。这里用 b 表示负质量，避免与谱状态 v 混淆。令

\[
\ell(\theta)=\log|f(e^{i\theta})|,
\quad x=\cot(\theta/2),\quad x_j=\cot(\theta_j/2),
\quad C_*:=\sum_ja_jx_j.
\]

由 SC 公式，远离各预顶点时

\[
\ell'(\theta)
=b\cot\frac\theta2-\sum_ja_j\cot\frac{\theta-\theta_j}2.
\tag{8.A9}
\]

利用初等恒等式

\[
-\cot\frac{\theta-\theta_j}2
=x_j+\frac{1+x_j^2}{x-x_j},
\]

得到

\[
\boxed{\ell'(\theta)=bx+C_*+
\sum_j\frac{a_j(1+x_j^2)}{x-x_j}.}
\tag{8.4}
\]

若 C*≥0，选 θ=0 右侧第一条弧 (0,ε)，其正端点是某个 θⱼ=ε。由式 (8.1)，ε≤1。cot(θ/2) 在 (0,2π) 上严格递减，因此在该弧上 x>0，且 x>xⱼ 对所有正节点均成立。式 (8.4) 中各项非负，故 ℓ 严格递增。

若 C*<0，选左侧末弧 (2π−ε,2π)。此时 x<0，x<xⱼ，全部项非正，故 ℓ 严格递减。反射 θ↦2π−θ 后，估计与右侧情况相同。这个选择使用唯一负原子；若还有其他负原子，就不能保证各项同号。

### 8.4 中央半弧的定量增量

只需证明右侧情况。设选中正端点的质量为 a，端点 ε。对 θ∈[ε/4,3ε/4]，

\[
x=\cot(\theta/2)\ge\cot(3\varepsilon/8)\ge c/\varepsilon.
\tag{8.A10}
\]

正端点在式 (8.4) 中的项可精确写成

\[
\frac{1+\cot^2(\varepsilon/2)}
{\cot(\theta/2)-\cot(\varepsilon/2)}
=\frac{\sin(\theta/2)}
{\sin(\varepsilon/2)\sin((\varepsilon-\theta)/2)}
\ge c/\varepsilon.
\tag{8.A11}
\]

最后一式用 sin(θ/2)≥θ/π、sin(ε/2)≤ε/2、sin((ε−θ)/2)≤(ε−θ)/2，且 θ、ε−θ 都位于 [ε/4,3ε/4]。保留这两项、舍去其余非负项后积分，得到

\[
\ell(3\varepsilon/4)-\ell(\varepsilon/4)
\ge\int_{\varepsilon/4}^{3\varepsilon/4}
\frac{c(a+b)}\varepsilon d\theta
\ge c'(a+b).
\tag{8.5}
\]

将参数方向选成 h=|f| 递减后，统一记

\[
\Delta_{\rm mid}\ell:=
\log h(\varepsilon/4)-\log h(3\varepsilon/4)
\ge c(a+b).
\tag{8.A12}
\]

常数与 ε 以及其他节点到端点的距离无关；未把其他正原子估计成可能很大的绝对误差。

### 8.5 从单调性得到质心偏差的下界

现在 h 在 (0,ε) 上递减。定义

\[
\mathsf A=\int_{0<s<t<\varepsilon}\frac{h(s)}{h(t)}dsdt,
\qquad
\mathsf B=\int_{0<s<t<\varepsilon}\frac{h(t)}{h(s)}dsdt.
\tag{8.A13}
\]

这些积分有限。事实上，负端点附近 h 与到该端点距离的 2b 次幂可比，正端点附近 h 与距离的 −2a 次幂可比；a,b<1/2 保证 ∫h 和 ∫h⁻¹ 都有限，且 A+B=(∫h)(∫h⁻¹)。单调性立即给 B≤ε²/2。

在矩形 0<s<ε/4、3ε/4<t<ε 上，h(s)/h(t)≥exp(Δ_midℓ)。故

\[
\mathsf A-\mathsf B
\ge\frac{\varepsilon^2}{16}\,2\sinh(\Delta_{\rm mid}\ell)
=\frac{\varepsilon^2}{8}\sinh(\Delta_{\rm mid}\ell).
\tag{8.A14}
\]

令 Y=A−B≥0，则

\[
\begin{aligned}
D:=\frac{\mathsf A-\mathsf B}{\mathsf A+\mathsf B}
&=\frac Y{Y+2\mathsf B}
\ge\frac Y{Y+\varepsilon^2}\\
&\ge\frac{\sinh(\Delta_{\rm mid}\ell)}
{8+\sinh(\Delta_{\rm mid}\ell)}
\ge c\min(\Delta_{\rm mid}\ell,1).
\end{aligned}
\]

由于 a+b<1，结合式 (8.A12) 得到

\[
\boxed{D\ge c(a+b).}
\tag{8.6}
\]

### 8.6 物理弧长换元及两个驻点矩

设该边物理长度为 L_E=∫₀εh(θ)dθ，并定义归一化物理坐标

\[
x(\theta)=L_E^{-1}\int_0^\theta h(s)ds,
\qquad k_0(x(\theta))=h(\theta)^{-2}.
\tag{8.A15}
\]

这里的 k₀ 是实非负函数，与第 4—5 节的解析函数 k=f⁻¹−1 不同。由 dx=h dθ/L_E，

\[
\int_0^1k_0dx=L_E^{-1}\int_0^\varepsilon h^{-1}d\theta,
\quad
\int_0^1xk_0dx=L_E^{-2}\mathsf A.
\]

再用 L_E∫h⁻¹=A+B，即得精确恒等式

\[
\frac{2\int_0^1(x-1/2)k_0dx}{\int_0^1k_0dx}
=\frac{2\mathsf A-(\mathsf A+\mathsf B)}{\mathsf A+\mathsf B}
=D.
\tag{8.A16}
\]

物理平方法向导数是 q(x)=p(θ(x))²k₀(x)。逐边的零阶矩与一阶矩相减，给

\[
\int_0^1(x-1/2)p(\theta(x))^2k_0(x)dx=0.
\tag{8.A17}
\]

设 M=max_Ip²、m=min_Ip²>0，c_p=(M+m)/2、d_p=(M−m)/2。由式 (8.A17)，

\[
\begin{aligned}
c_p\left|\int_0^1(x-1/2)k_0dx\right|
&=\left|\int_0^1(x-1/2)(c_p-p^2)k_0dx\right|\\
&\le\frac{d_p}{2}\int_0^1k_0dx.
\end{aligned}
\]

因此

\[
\boxed{D\le\frac{M-m}{M+m}\le C\operatorname{osc}_Ip.}
\tag{8.7}
\]

最后一个常数统一，是因为式 (8.A6)–(8.A8) 给 p_D/2≤p≤2p_D。将式 (8.3)、(8.6)、(8.7) 合并，得到

\[
\boxed{a+b\le C S^{3/4}\sqrt{\log(e/S)},
\qquad a\le CN^{-9/4}\sqrt{\log N}.}
\tag{8.8}
\]

其中第二式使用 S≤CN⁻³。得到小正端点质量 a 是删除论证所需的结论；这里只证明质量小，没有在实际多边形中删去或合并顶点。

**本节结论的地位。** 在第 3 节的统一 C¹ 展开及真实逐边驻点矩成立的前提下，上述单反角推导已逐步展开。若将“唯一负原子”改成多个负原子，式 (8.4) 的同号性不再成立；本节没有提出那种推广。多个反角在第 9.1 节通过正原子个数直接处理。

## 9. 阈值矛盾与大 N 主命题

现在假设 P 驻定且满足式 (1.2)，并反设非凸。

### 9.1 至少两个反角

此时凸角个数 p≤N−2。式 (6.7) 给

\[
\mathcal J(P)\ge1+\frac{4\zeta(3)}{(N-2)^3}-o(N^{-4}).
\tag{9.1}
\]

而 J(P)≤J(R_{N−1}) 给上界 1+4ζ(3)/(N−1)³+O(N⁻⁵)。两者相差正的 N⁻⁴ 主项，矛盾。因此只剩单反角。

### 9.2 单反角的能量缺口控制势函数

此时 p=N−1。记

\[
\delta=E_b(\mu)-B_p\ge0.
\]

由低谱上界、式 (6.6)–(6.7)，

\[
\delta\le CN^{-9/2}\sqrt{\log N},\qquad E_b(\mu)=O(N^{-3}).
\tag{9.2}
\]

定义核势

\[
U_b(\theta)=\sum_{n\ge1}b_n
\operatorname{Re}(\widehat\mu(n)e^{in\theta}).
\]

令 E(t)=Σe⁻ⁿᵗ|μhat(n)|²、E₀(t)=1/(eᵖᵗ−1)。式 (6.1) 给 E≥E₀，且 δ=∫w(E−E₀)。Fourier Cauchy–Schwarz 和式 (6.4) 给

\[
|U_b(\theta)|\le\int_0^\infty
w(t)\sqrt{\frac{E(t)}{e^t-1}}dt.
\]

将 √E≤√(E−E₀)+√E₀ 分开。第一项≤C√δ，因为 ∫w/(eᵗ−1) 有限；第二项利用 w≤t²/2、eᵗ−1≥t，再作 s=pt 换元，至多 Cp⁻⁵ᐟ²。因此

\[
\boxed{\|U_b\|_\infty\le C\sqrt\delta+Cp^{-5/2}.}
\tag{9.3}
\]

### 9.3 删除一个小正原子

取式 (8.8) 的正原子 aδθ*，定义总质量仍为 1 的有符号测度

\[
\widetilde\mu=\frac{\mu-a\delta_{\theta_*}}{1-a}.
\tag{9.4}
\]

记 K_b(0)=Σbₙ<∞，直接展开得精确恒等式

\[
E_b(\widetilde\mu)-E_b(\mu)
=\frac{2a(E_b(\mu)-U_b(\theta_*))
+a^2(K_b(0)-E_b(\mu))}{(1-a)^2}.
\tag{9.5}
\]

式 (8.8)、(9.2)–(9.3) 因而给

\[
\boxed{|E_b(\widetilde\mu)-E_b(\mu)|
\le CN^{-9/2}\log N=o(N^{-4}).}
\tag{9.6}
\]

删除后正原子恰为 N−2 个，所以 E_b(μtilde)≥B_{N−2}。μtilde 不必满足一阶 Fourier 中心化，也不必对应实际多边形：式 (6.5) 对全部总质量 1 的有符号测度成立，而 E_b 保留了全部 n≥1 模式。实际谱下界只对原 P、原 μ 使用。

因此从式 (6.7) 再得

\[
\mathcal J(P)\ge1+4B_{N-2}-o(N^{-4})
\ge1+\frac{4\zeta(3)}{(N-2)^3}-o(N^{-4}),
\]

同样与 J(P)≤J(R_{N−1}) 矛盾。

两种反角数量均被排除。这完成了主命题 A 的拟议推导；其统一性依赖第 2.4、3.4、5 节中已补写的分析入口与误差估计。数学审阅确认这些步骤后，N₀ 无需依赖局部角度或预顶点分离参数。

## 10. 从驻点不存在得到精确保面积下降

设 N≥N₀，P 为普通非凸 N 边形，J(P)<m_{N−1}。因为 m_{N−1}≤J(R_{N−1})，主命题说明 P 不是面积驻点。

以原顶点组成坐标向量 X，面积为 A(X)，定义面积切向的特征值梯度

\[
Z=\nabla\lambda_1(X)
-\frac{\nabla\lambda_1(X)\cdot\nabla A(X)}{|\nabla A(X)|^2}\nabla A(X).
\tag{10.1}
\]

Euler 齐次关系 X·∇A=2A>0 保证分母非零；非驻点保证 Z≠0。取 V=−Z，有 A′(X)V=0、λ′(X)V=−|Z|²<0。定义

\[
X(t)=\sqrt{\frac{A(X)}{A(X+tV)}}(X+tV).
\tag{10.2}
\]

+Let $M\ge4$, $\alpha=2/M$, and $c_q=(\alpha)_q/q!$. Then
+$$
+\sum_{q\ge1}\frac{c_q^2}{qM+1}
+=\frac{4\zeta(3)}{M^3}+O(M^{-5}),
+$$

+Write
+$$
+c_q=\frac\alpha qP_q,
+\qquad P_q=\prod_{r=1}^{q-1}\left(1+\frac\alpha r\right),
+\qquad H_q=\sum_{r=1}^q\frac1r.
+$$
+Set $Q=\lfloor e^{1/(4\alpha)}\rfloor$. For $q\le Q$, $\alpha H_{q-1}\le1/2$ and the product expansion with a positive remainder gives
+$$
+P_q=1+\alpha H_{q-1}+R_q,
+\qquad |R_q|\le C\alpha^2(1+H_{q-1}^2).
+$$
+Also
+$$
+\frac1{qM+1}=\frac1{qM}-\frac1{q^2M^2}+O\left(\frac1{q^3M^3}\right).
+$$
+Substitution, using convergence of $\sum q^{-3}$, $\sum H_{q-1}q^{-3}$ and $\sum(1+H_{q-1}^2)q^{-3}$, gives
+$$
+\sum_{q\le Q}\frac{c_q^2}{qM+1}
+=\frac{\alpha^2}{M}\zeta(3)
+ +\frac{2\alpha^3}{M}\sum_{q\ge1}\frac{H_{q-1}}{q^3}
+ -\frac{\alpha^2}{M^2}\zeta(4)+O(M^{-5}).
+$$
+The standard Euler sum $\sum_{q\ge1}H_{q-1}/q^3=\zeta(4)/4$ and $\alpha=2/M$ make the two $M^{-4}$ terms cancel, leaving $4\zeta(3)M^{-3}+O(M^{-5})$.
+

+$$
+\sum_{q>Q}\frac{c_q^2}{qM+1}
+\le\frac{C\alpha^2}{M}\sum_{q>Q}q^{-3+2\alpha}
+\le C M^{-3}e^{-1/(2\alpha)}=O(M^{-5}).
+$$
+This proves the claim.
+:::

For the unit-area regular $M$-gon in @def-j-functional,
$$
\frac{J(R_M)}{\pi j^2}=1+\frac{4\zeta(3)}{M^3}+O(M^{-9/2})
\quad (M\to\infty).
$$

::: {.proof of="lem-regular-polygon-asymptotic" status="verified"}
Use the similarity-normalized conformal map. For the regular $M$-gon its Schwarz--Christoffel derivative is
$$
F_M'(z)=(1-z^M)^{-2/M}=1+g_M(z),qquad
g_M(z)=\sum_{q\ge1}c_qz^{qM},qquad
c_q=\frac{(2/M)_q}{q!}.
$$
By @lem-regular-sc-coefficient-sum and @def-conformal-data,
$$
S_M=\sum_{q\ge1}\frac{c_q^2}{qM+1}
=\frac{4\zeta(3)}{M^3}+O(M^{-5}).
$$

Apply @lem-disk-perturbation to $g_M$. The quadratic correction satisfies
$$
\left|\sum_{q\ge1}\frac{\rho_{qM}}{(qM+1)^2}c_q^2\right|
\le C\sum_{q\ge1}\frac{c_q^2}{(qM+1)^3}=O(M^{-5}),
$$
using @lem-bessel-ratio-decay. Since $S_M^{3/2}=O(M^{-9/2})$, the perturbation expansion yields
$$
\frac{J(R_M)}{\pi j^2}=1+\frac{4\zeta(3)}{M^3}+O(M^{-9/2}).
$$
:::

There is $N_1$ such that no stationary admissible $N$-gon in the sense of @def-stationary-polygon, with at least two reflex corners, satisfying @lem-edge-moments, @lem-spectral-core, and the regime of @lem-near-circle-conformal, and with $J$ as in @def-j-functional, satisfies
$$
J(P)\le J(R_{N-1})
$$
for $N\ge N_1$.
:::
